title: Piston-Like Information Engine II: Boundary-Controlled Optimum in Active Matter
summary: Information engines convert information into extractable work through measurements and feedback. We realize an engine that employs information to compress a gas of self-propelled bristle bots. Its work per measurement, $\bar{W}$, is controlled by the size of the detection region $Δx$ and the probability $p_1$ that this region is vacant. In thermal systems, $\bar{W}$ follows the universal form $-p_1 \ln p_1$, whereas the active engine shows a qualitatively modified relation. As particle density increases, the maximum of $\bar{W}(Δx)$ switches between two distinct operating regimes. Notably, this transition is also found in the solutions that maximize power output for finite-time cycles with dynamics affected by dry friction. We attribute this nonequilibrium feature to the accumulation of active particles near the boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文实现了一种利用信息压缩自驱动"鬃毛机器人"气体以提取功的信息引擎。研究发现，在热系统中做功遵循普遍形式$-p_1 \ln p_1$，而活性引擎表现出质性的修正关系。随着粒子密度增加，做功最大值在两种工作状态之间切换，这一转变也出现在受干摩擦影响的有限时间循环中，归因于活性粒子在边界附近的累积。
AI.motivation: 探索活性物质系统中信息引擎的行为，特别是与热平衡系统相比，活性粒子如何改变信息-功转换的普遍规律，从而揭示非平衡系统中的新物理现象。
AI.method: 利用自驱动鬃毛机器人（bristle bots）作为活性粒子气体，构建信息引擎。通过测量和反馈机制压缩粒子气体来提取功，系统研究做功$\bar{W}$与检测区域大小$Δx$和区域空闲概率$p_1$的关系，并分析粒子密度变化对工作状态的影响。
AI.result: 活性引擎的做功关系偏离了热系统的普遍形式$-p_1 \ln p_1$。做功最大值$\bar{W}(Δx)$随粒子密度增加在两种不同工作模式间切换，这种转变同样出现在干摩擦动力学约束的有限时间周期中。
AI.conclusion: 活性引擎的非平衡特征源于活性粒子在边界的累积，这为理解活性系统中信息驱动的能量转换提供了新视角，也揭示了与干摩擦动力学的有趣联系。

title: Microscopic dynamics of contagion using active Brownian particles: universal scaling and propagation controlled by protection
comment: Accepted for publication in Revista Mexicana de Física
summary: Understanding how individual protection and population density influence epidemic spreading remains a central challenge in epidemiology. While classical compartmental models successfully describe the temporal evolution of epidemics, they do not explicitly account for the microscopic motion and spatial organisation of individuals. Here, we investigate contagion dynamics using an agent-based model of Active Brownian Particles (ABPs), where self-propelled agents interact through local contact and a prescribed fraction of the population is protected. By systematically varying the protected-agent fraction and the population density, we identify two distinct contagion regimes separated by a crossover protection of approximately $30\%$. Below this threshold, the maximum contagion rate follows the universal scaling $ν_{\mathrm{max}}\proptoφ^{1/2}$, indicating that disease transmission is governed primarily by frequency of encounters. Above the threshold, universal scaling is lost and protection becomes the dominant mechanism controlling epidemic spreading, with the strongest suppression occurring in low-density populations. These results demonstrate that microscopic active-matter models provide a powerful framework for investigating epidemic dynamics beyond the assumptions of well-mixed population models and reveal how spatial organisation and individual protection jointly determine contagion dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用活性布朗粒子（ABPs）的基于个体的模型研究传染病动力学，发现当受保护个体比例低于约30%时，最大传染率遵循普适标度律ν_max∝φ^{1/2}（由接触频率主导）；超过该阈值后，普适标度失效，保护机制成为控制疫情传播的主导因素，且在低密度群体中抑制效果最强。
AI.motivation: 传统的房室模型（如SIR）虽能描述疫情的时间演化，但未显式考虑个体的微观运动和空间组织。理解个体保护与种群密度如何共同影响疫情传播仍是一个核心挑战，需要更微观的建模框架。
AI.method: 采用基于活性布朗粒子（ABPs）的个体模型：自推进粒子通过局部接触相互作用，系统中预设一定比例的受保护个体。通过系统性地改变受保护个体比例和种群密度，研究疫情的传播动力学。
AI.result: 识别出由约30%交叉保护阈值分隔的两个截然不同的传染机制：低于阈值时，最大传染率遵循普适标度ν_max∝φ^{1/2}（由接触频率主导）；高于阈值时，普适标度性丧失，保护成为主导因素，且低密度种群中疫情抑制最强。
AI.conclusion: 微观活性物质模型为研究超出混合均匀假设的疫情动态提供了强大框架，揭示了空间组织和个体保护如何共同决定传染动力学。

title: Nonequilibrium corrections to conserved Ising criticality in scalar active matter: Ward identities, spectrum, and long crossovers
summary: Active scalar field theories break detailed balance in two physically distinct ways: through a field-dependent noise-to-mobility ratio $Θ(φ)=D(φ)/M(φ)$, and through the gradient activity of Active Model~B+. We classify the resulting perturbations of the conserved Wilson-Fisher fixed point in three dimensions. Working from the Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-De~Dominicis (MSRJD) action, a functional renormalization-group (FRG) calculation shows that the transport sector has a block-triangular stability matrix whose leading odd mode has $y_{Θ_1}=-Δ_φ$, while quotienting the gradient sector by its detailed-balance-preserving tangent leaves a chemical and a current-like mode. Two smooth regulators give $y_{Θ_1}\simeq-0.52$, $y_J\simeq-0.56$ and $y_{\rm ch}\simeq-0.89$. The translation Ward identity represents the current operator by a stress-tensor divergence modulo chemical gradients; conservation and causality then make the active stability matrix triangular to all loop orders, and an explicit two-loop calculation in $d=4-ε$ finds no additional contact counterterm. The two slowest modes are separated only by the Ising anomalous dimension, $y_J-y_{Θ_1}=-η$. This relation is a dimension count that holds provided neither operator acquires a further contact anomaly, a condition we establish within the present truncation for $\mathcal O_Θ$ and verify through two loops for $\mathcal O_J$; under it the $d=3$ reference Ising value gives $y_{Θ_1}\simeq-0.5181$ and $y_J\simeq-0.5544$. We derive the parity-resolved finite-size scaling of this near degeneracy, identify block observables that separate the two modes, and show that when the current amplitude dominates the crossover scale lies far beyond any accessible system size.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了三维空间中活动标量场理论对守恒Wilson-Fisher不动点的两类破坏细致平衡的微扰（通过噪声-迁移率比Θ(φ)和Active Model B+的梯度活性）。利用Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-De Dominicis作用和泛函重整化群计算，作者发现输运扇区具有块三角稳定性矩阵，并通过平移Ward恒等式证明活动稳定性矩阵在所有圈阶都是三角的。两圈计算确认无额外接触反项，两个最慢模式的分离恰好由Ising反常维度η决定。
AI.motivation: 活动标量场理论通过两种物理上不同的方式破坏细致平衡，理解这两种微扰对守恒Wilson-Fisher不动点的影响对于分类非平衡临界现象至关重要。此前缺乏对这些微扰在临界点处的普适分类和定量刻画。
AI.method: 从MSRJD作用量出发，采用泛函重整化群(FRG)方法分析输运扇区的稳定性矩阵；利用平移Ward恒等式将电流算子表示为应力张量散度模化学梯度；在d=4-ε维进行显式两圈计算验证；推导奇偶分辨的有限尺寸标度，并构造可以分离两种模式的块观测量。
AI.result: 两种平滑规范给出y_{Θ_1}≈-0.52, y_J≈-0.56, y_ch≈-0.89。两圈计算确认无额外接触反项。关键关系y_J-y_{Θ_1}=-η成立，参考d=3 Ising值给出y_{Θ_1}≈-0.5181和y_J≈-0.5544。两种模式仅由Ising反常维度分离，是近简并的。
AI.conclusion: 活动标度场的两种破坏细致平衡的微扰在三维临界点上产生了由Ising反常维度η控制的近简并输运模式。当电流幅度占优时，交叉尺度远超任何可及的系统尺寸，这具有重要的实验和数值模拟意义。平移Ward恒等式和因果性保证了活动稳定性矩阵在所有圈阶的三角结构。

title: Effect of reactive targets on diffusive transport with intermittent restarts
summary: We study search processes in a complex environment using the strategy of stochastic resetting. A common occurrence in these environments is targets with finite reactivity. Stochastic resetting has emerged as a powerful mechanism for optimizing search processes by curtailing long, unproductive excursions inherent to diffusive dynamics. Most theoretical studies, however, assume perfectly absorbing targets -- an idealization that overlooks the finite reactivity commonly encountered in realistic chemical and biological systems. In this work, we investigate the interplay between stochastic resetting and finite-target reactivity in reaction - diffusion processes. Considering a one-dimensional system with multiple reactive targets, we demonstrated that the target reactivity modifies the optimization landscape. We uncover distinct regimes in which resetting enhances transport efficiency towards specific targets based on their chemical kinetics. As a consequence, the optimal resetting rate becomes intrinsically reactivity dependent. Our results identify target reactivity as a crucial control parameter governing stochastic transport and provide insights into reaction-diffusion processes in complex media.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了复杂环境中随机重置策略下的搜索过程，重点关注具有有限反应活性的靶标。在一维系统中考虑多个反应靶标时，发现靶标反应活性会改变随机重置的优化景观，且最优重置率强烈依赖于靶标的化学动力学特性。
AI.motivation: 大多数理论研究假设靶标为完美吸收体，忽略了现实化学和生物系统中普遍存在的有限反应活性，这会导致模型偏离实际。
AI.method: 在一维反应-扩散系统中考虑多个有限反应活性的靶标，分析随机重置与靶标反应活性之间的相互作用，研究不同反应动力学条件下重置对特定靶标输运效率的增强效应。
AI.result: 发现靶标反应活性会修改重置的优化景观，识别出不同的机制区间，在这些区间中重置对不同化学动力学靶标的输运效率提升效果不同。最优重置率本质上依赖于靶标反应活性。
AI.conclusion: 靶标反应活性是控制随机输运的关键参数，为理解复杂介质中的反应-扩散过程提供了新的见解。

title: Learning a general class of admissible multi-species collision operators from molecular dynamics
summary: We develop a structure-preserving, data-driven collision operator for spatially homogeneous multi-species kinetic systems from molecular dynamics (MD). The operator consists of diagonal self-collision blocks and ordered off-diagonal cross-species blocks to describe intra- and inter-species momentum and energy exchange. Within a local and point-wise identifiable kernel class, we develop the necessary and sufficient condition for the admissible kernel class satisfying the conservation laws, the H-theorem, and the frame indifference. Unlike the classical Landau operator, the off-diagonal kernels are not restricted to be symmetric under permutation of the two velocity variables. This unique structural freedom captures the distinct responses of different species to unresolved correlations and many-body effects arising from micro-scale particle interactions. The equivalent parameterizable kernel formalization enables us to learn a generalized data-driven collision operator directly from MD, where the low-rank tensor representations and random sampling are used to achieve efficient kernel training and numerical simulation. Numerical experiments show that the learned operator accurately predicts transport coefficients and the non-equilibrium relaxation, while retaining discrete conservation and entropy production. In particular, it captures plasma kinetics in the moderately coupled regime, where the predictions of both the Landau and the data-driven model restricted to velocity-permutation symmetry show significant discrepancies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构保持、数据驱动的多物种动力学碰撞算子，从分子动力学中学习，能够刻画物种间动量与能量交换，并在中等耦合等离子体区显著优于Landau算子及受限于速度置换对称的模型。
AI.motivation: 经典Landau算子对多物种系统采用对称交叉核，无法捕捉不同物种对未解析关联和多体效应的差异化响应，尤其在中度耦合等离子体区预测出现显著偏差。
AI.method: 构建由对角自碰撞块与非对角交叉物种块组成的碰撞算子；在局部可点识别核类中推导满足守恒律、H定理和框架无关性的充要条件（不要求非对角核在速度置换下对称）；利用低秩张量表示与随机采样实现从MD直接学习广义数据驱动碰撞算子。
AI.result: 数值实验表明学习到的算子能准确预测输运系数和非平衡弛豫，同时保持离散守恒与熵产生；在中等耦合等离子体区优于Landau算子及受限于速度置换对称的数据驱动模型。
AI.conclusion: 打破传统对称性约束、为不同物种赋予结构自由的碰撞算子，为从微观分子动力学到宏观动力学建模提供了更精确且物理一致的路径。

title: A Spatial Localizer for Constituent-Resolved Exciton Wannier Functions
summary: The internal electron-hole structure of excitons influences optical and electric-field responses. Exciton Wannier functions have recently provided a local real-space representation of exciton bands. Because excitons are composite quasiparticles, these Wannier functions can be characterized by both their center-of-mass location and the internal electron-hole dipole. Resolving this internal structure in real space requires simultaneously locating the constituent electron and hole coordinates. However, the projected electron and hole position operators generally do not commute, so simultaneous diagonalization of these positions is impossible: their noncommutativity precludes a common eigenbasis and imposes a state-dependent lower bound on the joint spread. Existing approaches localize a single average coordinate or a specific constituent coordinate, but generally do not construct a common exciton Wannier basis that maximally localizes both constituent coordinates. Here, we construct an ``exciton spatial localizer'': a single Hermitian operator that embeds the constituent position operators within a Clifford-algebra structure and returns exciton Wannier functions, maximally localized in their electron and hole coordinates simultaneously. Our formulation is ansatz-free, gauge-invariant, and applies to the generic multiband case. In an interacting bilayer model with an isolated group of exciton bands, we show that reflection and time-reversal symmetries, or other nonsymmorphic symmetries detailed herein, enforce a pointwise traceless but nonzero quantum geometric dipole matrix, which manifests in symmetry-related pairs of exciton Wannier functions with equal and opposite internal electron-hole dipoles.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个"激子空间局域化算符"，通过Clifford代数结构嵌入电子和空穴位置算符，从而同时最大化局域化激子的电子与空穴坐标，得到共同的激子Wannier基。该方法是无试探、规范不变的，适用于一般多带情形。
AI.motivation: 激子作为复合准粒子，其内部电子-空穴结构影响光学和电场响应。由于投影的电子与空穴位置算符一般不对易，无法同时对角化两者坐标，导致现有方法只能局域化单一平均坐标或单一组成坐标，无法构建同时最大化局域化两个组成坐标的公共激子Wannier基。
AI.method: 构建一个"激子空间局域化算符"（exciton spatial localizer）：这是一个单一的Hermitian算符，将组成位置算符嵌入到Clifford代数结构中，其本征函数即激子Wannier函数，可实现电子和空穴坐标的同时最大化局域化。该方法无试探参数、规范不变，并适用于一般多带情形。
AI.result: 在具有孤立激子带组的相互作用双层模型中，证明了反射和时间反演对称性（或其他非对称性对称）强制实现逐点无迹但非零的量子几何偶极矩阵，表现为对称性关联的激子Wannier函数对具有等大反向的内部电子-空穴偶极。
AI.conclusion: 该方法克服了电子与空穴位置算符不对易带来的根本障碍，提供了同时局域化激子组成坐标的激子Wannier基，并揭示了对称性如何决定激子内部偶极结构。

title: Tuning Boron-Vacancy Qubit Coherence through Layer Number in hBN
summary:
The negatively charged boron vacancy ($\VB$) in hexagonal boron nitride (\hBN{}) was the first optically addressable spin qubit identified inside a van der Waals crystal, allowing atomically defined placement relative to a target. Its coherence in bulk \hBN{} is limited by the boron nuclei of the layers flanking the defect plane, which a thin flake removes. Here, we use a generalized cluster-correlation expansion with an extended central-spin block to calculate the Hahn-echo coherence time of $\VB$ in h$^{11}$B$^{15}$N as a function of layer number. Our results show that $T_2$ rises from $199
s$ in the bulk limit to $653
s$ in a monolayer, a factor of $3.3$ that is already saturated at three layers and that a sublattice decomposition attributes entirely to boron. The enhancement is confined to low field, is insensitive to stacking registry and twist angle, and requires alignment to within about two degrees, an onset we reproduce with no free parameters. Under dynamical decoupling, a $1/e$ threshold returns $206
s$ for every thickness, but this is a zero of the first-shell modulation rather than a decay: measured without a threshold, the layer contrast survives and reaches a factor of $170$. Layer number thus emerges as a design parameter for $\VB$-based sensing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过广义簇关联展开方法，系统计算了六方氮化硼(hBN)中硼空位(VB)自旋的Hahn回波相干时间T2随层数的变化。研究发现T2从体材料极限的199ns提升到单层的653ns，提升3.3倍且在3层时即饱和。该增强仅局限于低磁场、对堆叠方式不敏感、要求对准角度约2度以内。在动力学解耦下，1/e阈值在每个厚度都返回206ns，但这实际上是第一壳层调制的零点而非真衰减——去掉阈值后层间对比度可达170倍。
AI.motivation: 硼空位(VB)是首个在范德华晶体中被识别出的可光学寻址自旋量子比特，其相干性在体材料中受缺陷平面两侧硼核限制。薄片可以移除这些核，因此理解层数如何影响相干时间对基于VB的量子传感具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用广义簇关联展开方法，并扩展中心自旋块，计算h¹¹B¹⁵N中VB的Hahn-echo相干时间T2随层数的函数关系。同时进行子晶格分解分析归因相干限制来源。
AI.result: T2从体材料极限的199ns提升至单层的653ns，提升3.3倍，且在3层时即达到饱和。增强仅存在于低磁场区域，不依赖于堆叠注册模式或扭转角，但要求对准角度约2度以内。在动力学解耦下，1/e阈值在各厚度均返回206ns，但这是第一壳层调制的零点而非真正的相干衰减，无阈值测量时层间对比度可达170倍。
AI.conclusion: 层数成为VB基自旋传感的一个设计参数。该工作揭示了VB相干性提升的物理机制与适用范围，为优化基于hBN的自旋量子比特器件提供了明确指导。

title: Evolution from Kitaev to XXZ spin chains via distortion: Application to BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$
summary: BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$ is a prototypical spin-orbit-coupled Ising-chain antiferromagnet that provides a unique platform for studying field-induced quantum magnetism. Under a transverse magnetic field, it exhibits unusual magnetic properties, including an anomalous staggered magnetization and a pronounced anisotropy of the critical field with respect to the in-plane field direction. While these phenomena have been attributed phenomenologically to a site-dependent anisotropic $g$-tensor, a recent microscopic theory has shown that spin-orbit coupling naturally generates bond-dependent Heisenberg, Kitaev, and $Γ$ exchange interactions. Here, we unify these two pictures by extending the microscopic theory to incorporate distortions of the CoO$_6$ octahedra. We show that the distortions not only generate the site-dependent anisotropic $g$-tensor but also renormalize the staggered exchange interactions through a distortion-induced contribution that partially compensates the Kitaev-derived staggered term. Using point-charge calculations to estimate the $g$-tensor of BaCo$_2$V$_2$O$_8$, we demonstrate that the strong anisotropy of the critical field originates from the combined effects of the modified exchange interactions and the anisotropic $g$-tensor. Our work provides a unified microscopic framework for understanding the magnetic anisotropy of spin-orbit-coupled Ising-chain materials.

AI.tldr: 本文统一了两种关于BaCo₂V₂O₈磁各向异性的理论视角：通过将微观理论扩展至包含CoO₆八面体畸变，证明畸变不仅产生依赖于位点的各向异性g张量，还通过畸变诱导的贡献重整化交错交换相互作用（部分补偿Kitaev衍生的交错项）。点电荷计算显示，临界场的强各向异性源于修正的交换相互作用与各向异性g张量的联合效应。
AI.motivation: BaCo₂V₂O₈在横向磁场下表现出异常的磁性（反常交错磁化、临界场强各向异性），此前有两种独立解释：唯象的位点依赖各向异性g张量模型，以及基于自旋轨道耦合微观理论的键依赖Heisenberg、Kitaev和Γ交换作用模型。本文旨在统一这两种图像。
AI.method: 将微观理论扩展以纳入CoO₆八面体畸变的影响；通过点电荷计算估算BaCo₂V₂O₈的g张量；分析畸变如何同时生成位点依赖的各向异性g张量并重整化交错交换相互作用。
AI.result: 证明八面体畸变既产生位点依赖的各向异性g张量，也通过畸变诱导贡献（部分补偿Kitaev衍生的交错项）重整化交错交换作用。基于点电荷计算的g张量显示，临界场的强各向异性源于修正交换作用与各向异性g张量的共同贡献。
AI.conclusion: 本文为理解自旋轨道耦合Ising链材料的磁各向异性提供了统一的微观框架，弥合了唯象g张量理论与微观交换作用理论之间的鸿沟。

title: Dodecahydrogen uranium: an icosahedral f-electron superatom with 26-electron shell structure
summary: A new icosahedral superatom UH$_{12}$ is reported and analyzed using post-Hartree-Fock multiconfigurational methods. A RASSCF/CASPT2/RASSI/SINGLE_ANISO workflow is employed to determine the electronic energy levels and magnetic properties. Superatomic characteristics, such as orbital topologies and shell filling order, are discussed. The high hydrogen-to-uranium ratio and potential for optically stimulated decomposition make UH$_{12}$ worth investigation in the context of hydrogen storage. The electric-dipole transition oscillator strengths of the molecule vanish, while its lowest electronic transitions fall in the THz and infrared ranges. The lowest septet manifold exhibits crystal-field splitting into a 1+3+3 pattern, as expected from icosahedral symmetry. In turn, the interlevel gaps within these crystal-field triplets are 30-150 GHz (1-5 cm$^{-1}$). The molecule is magnetically isotropic at low fields, while its levels exhibit higher-order Zeeman anisotropy that becomes significant around 2 Tesla. These properties suggest potential relevance for quantum computing, quantum communication, and quantum memory, including qubit- and qudit-based architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文报道并分析了一种新的二十面体超原子UH12，采用RASSCF/CASPT2/RASSI/SINGLE_ANISO后Hartree-Fock多组态方法研究其电子能级和磁性。该分子具有高氢铀比，电子跃迁位于太赫兹和红外波段，最低七重态在二十面体对称性下劈裂为1+3+3模式，晶场三重态内能隙为30-150 GHz，低场下磁各向同性而在约2特斯拉处呈现高阶Zeeman各向异性，暗示其在量子计算、量子通信和量子存储（包括qubit和qudit架构）中的潜在应用。
AI.motivation: 探索UH12作为新型二十面体超原子的电子结构和磁性特性，一方面评估其在氢存储方面的潜力（高氢铀比及光致分解可能性），另一方面由于其THz/红外跃迁、特定的晶场劈裂模式和磁性行为，评估其在量子信息处理中的潜在应用价值。
AI.method: 采用后Hartree-Fock多组态方法，具体包括RASSCF（受限活性空间自洽场）、CASPT2（完全活性空间二阶微扰理论）、RASSI（受限活性空间态相互作用）和SINGLE_ANISO计算流程，以确定电子能级和磁性质。同时分析超原子轨道拓扑和壳层填充顺序。
AI.result: 电偶极跃迁振子强度为零，最低电子跃迁落在THz和红外范围。最低七重态在二十面体对称性下劈裂为1+3+3的晶场模式，三重态内能隙为30-150 GHz（1-5 cm^-1）。分子在低场下磁各向同性，其能级在约2特斯拉处表现出显著的高阶Zeeman各向异性。
AI.conclusion: UH12独特的电子结构和磁性特性（THz/红外跃迁、晶场劈裂模式、高阶Zeeman各向异性）使其在量子计算、量子通信和量子存储领域具有潜在相关性，可支持基于qubit和qudit的架构设计。同时其在氢存储方向上也可能具有研究价值。

title: Interaction effects on Andreev states from an electromagnetic environment
summary:
Here we present a detailed theoretical investigation of the environment-induced interaction correction to the ground states and addition energies in a short superconducting junction. We derive general formulas for these corrections linking them to the frequency-dependent admittance of the junction and the environment impedance. We specify two environmental models: that of an external impedance and the Mattis-Bardeen model. In both cases we assume $G_Q Z \ll 1$, where $G_Q$ is the conductance quantum and $Z$ the typical environmental resistance.
  While an expectation is that the typical scale of the relative correction is of the order $G_Q Z$, we have found that in many cases the dimensionless scale $L G_Q Δ$ provides a better estimation, where $Δ$ is the superconducting energy gap and $L$ an external inductance. We discuss the logarithmic renormalizations of the energies by low- and high-frequency phase fluctuations and single out a non-superconducting contribution related to the renormalization of transmission eigenvalues. We investigate in detail the peculiarities of the corrections at: i. small phases, where the interaction causes a current jump, ii. Andreev bound state energies close to the gap edge, iii. Andreev bound state energies close to Fermi level. In all these cases the correction may become comparable with the unperturbed energy, even for $G_Q Z \ll 1$, and we briefly sketch non-perturbative models relevant for the situations.

AI.tldr: 本文对短超导结中环境诱导的相互作用对基态和加入能的修正进行了详细的理论研究。
AI.motivation: 理解环境阻抗与超导结之间的相互作用如何修正结的基态能量和加入能，这对于纳米尺度超导器件的量子行为至关重要。
AI.method: 推导了将修正与结的频率相关导纳及环境阻抗联系起来的一般公式，并研究了两种环境模型（外部阻抗模型和Mattis-Bardeen模型），在G_Q Z << 1的小参数假设下进行分析。
AI.result: 发现修正的典型标度在许多情况下由LG_QΔ而非G_QZ决定；在三个特殊区域（小相位、Andreev束缚态能量接近能隙边缘、接近费米能级）修正可能变得与未扰动能量相当；此外还讨论了低/高频相位涨落引起的对数重整化及透射本征值重整化的非超导贡献。
AI.conclusion: 即使在G_Q Z << 1的条件下，环境诱导的修正也可能在某些特殊情况下显著甚至与未扰动能量可比，因此需要非微扰模型来处理这些情形。

title: Impedance in Periodically Driven Stochastic Systems
summary: We study the time-dependent currents arising in periodically driven stochastic systems. In the linear regime of small driving, a closed expression is obtained for the impedance/admittance associated with these currents. This expression leads directly to an interpretation in terms of an equivalent electrical circuit. For a stochastic system with $N$ states, the electrical circuit consists of precisely $N$ parallel branches, with each branch comprising a resistor and a capacitor in series. The low- and high-frequency limits of these currents are calculated, and the results are generalized to more general current expressions. We demonstrate our findings across several archetypal settings, illustrating the potential to detect specific broken symmetries or the graph topology associated with the stochastic process.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了周期性驱动的随机系统中随时间变化的电流。在小驱动线性区域，推导出电流的阻抗/导纳闭合表达式，并将其解释为等效电路：N态随机系统对应N条并联支路，每条支路由电阻和电容串联组成。计算了低频和高频极限，并将结果推广到更一般的电流表达式，展示了检测破缺对称性和图拓扑的能力。
AI.motivation: 周期性驱动的随机系统广泛存在于物理、化学和生物系统中，理解其时变电流行为对揭示系统内在对称性和网络拓扑具有重要意义。作者希望建立随机动力学与电路理论之间的桥梁，为探测系统微观结构和对称性提供新的理论工具。
AI.method: 在线性响应（小驱动）框架下，作者推导了周期性驱动随机系统中电流的阻抗/导纳闭合表达式。该表达式被映射到一个等效电路模型，其中N态随机系统对应N条并联的RC串联支路。同时分析了低频率和高频率两个极限情况，并将军到更一般的电流定义。
AI.result: 获得了电流阻抗的闭式解；建立了随机系统与RC并联电路的严格对应关系；给出了低频和高频极限的解析结果；在多个典型系统中验证了理论，证明该方法能够检测特定的对称性破缺以及随机过程的图拓扑结构。
AI.conclusion: 周期性驱动随机系统的线性响应可被优雅地表示为等效电路阻抗，这一映射不仅提供了直观的物理图像，还为利用频域响应探测随机过程的对称性和拓扑结构提供了新工具，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Physics-informed Learning for Orbital Uncertainty Propagation with Error Bounds
summary: The Fokker-Planck partial differential equation (FP-PDE) governs uncertainty evolution in stochastic dynamical systems. In orbital dynamics, solving the FP-PDE is challenging because of nonlinear motion, high-dimensional states, and large space-time domains. We develop a physics-informed neural network (PINN) approach that approximates the FP-PDE solution as a single space-time probability density, while also quantifying its worst-case approximation error. This approach is, in principle, independent of the choice of state coordinates and neural network architecture. Specifically, to enforce probability density function (PDF) properties into the neural network, we design a Physics-informed Gaussian mixture model (PINN-GMM). Then a companion error PINN learns the dynamics of the approximation error and yields time-dependent bounds that define an ambiguity set of PDFs. This ambiguity set enables rigorous computation of upper and lower bounds on event probabilities through tractable linear programs. Numerical studies on illustrative 1D examples and several 4D--6D orbital test cases demonstrate accurate uncertainty propagation, correct and informative error bounds, and improved reliability over common uncertainty-propagation baseline methods (Gaussian approximation, unscented transform, and Gaussian mixture model). Constructing the PINN-GMM requires offline training, making it costlier than the baseline approximations; once trained, however, a single forward pass returns the density at any time in sub-millisecond time $(0.16~\mathrm{ms}$ in our implementation).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的Fokker-Planck偏微分方程求解方法（PINN-GMM），用于轨道动力学中的不确定性传播。该方法将网络输出构造成高斯混合模型以满足概率密度性质，并通过伴随误差网络量化最坏情况近似误差，从而生成随时间变化的PDF界，实现事件概率的严格上下界计算。在1D示例及4D-6D轨道算例中，该方法在精度和可靠性上优于高斯近似、无迹变换和高斯混合模型等基准方法。
AI.motivation: 轨道动力学中的不确定性传播面临Fokker-Planck PDE求解挑战，原因包括非线性运动、高维状态和大时空域。传统近似方法（如高斯近似、无迹变换、高斯混合模型）缺乏严格的误差保证，难以提供可靠的不确定性量化。
AI.method: 1) 设计Physics-informed Gaussian mixture model (PINN-GMM)，将神经网络的输出构造为高斯混合模型，从而在架构层面融入PDF归一化和非负性等概率性质；2) 引入伴随误差PINN学习逼近误差的动力学演化，产生时变边界以定义PDF的模糊集（ambiguity set）；3) 利用该模糊集通过可解的线性规划严格计算事件概率的上下界。方法原则上不依赖于状态坐标系选择和神经网络架构。
AI.result: 在1D示例和多个4D-6D轨道测试案例中，该方法实现了准确的不确定性传播、正确且具信息量的误差边界，可靠性和精度优于高斯近似、无迹变换和高斯混合模型等常用基准方法。虽然离线训练成本较高，但训练完成后单次前向传播仅需0.16毫秒即可在任何时刻获得密度。
AI.conclusion: PINN-GMM为轨道动力学中的非线性不确定性传播提供了一种兼具精度与严格误差保证的新方法，通过一次性离线训练实现近乎实时的在线推断，为高维轨道不确定性量化提供了一种可行的替代方案。

title: Symmetry-selective nonrelativistic spin splitting in antiferromagnets driven by coherent phonons
summary: Nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in antiferromagnets (AFMs) enables magnetization-free spin polarization for ultrafast spintronics. Here, we demonstrate that coherent phonons can dynamically induce and control NRSS in collinear AFMs. Excitation of $Γ$-point infrared-active phonons lifts the spin degeneracy of the ground state, while the residual sublattice-connecting symmetries determine the momentum-space form of the induced splitting. Because the relevant infrared modes couple to orthogonal in-plane light polarizations, distinct spin-split phases can be selectively activated by the polarization of the driving field. Using first-principles calculations for MnPS$_3$, we show that a mode that breaks all sublattice-connecting symmetries induces an $s$-wave spin-split state with $Δ(Γ)\neq0$, whereas a symmetry-distinct mode that preserves a sublattice-connecting mirror symmetry generates a $d$-wave altermagnetic state with $Δ(Γ)=0$. In both cases, the spin splitting grows linearly with the phonon amplitude and reverses the induced spin polarization when the displacement is reversed. Our results establish coherent lattice driving as a direct, polarization- and mode-selective route to dynamically induce distinct NRSS phases in AFMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过第一性原理计算证明，相干声子（红外活性声子）可在共线反铁磁体中动态诱导和控制非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS）。在MnPS₃中，不同对称性的声子模式可选择性地产生s波自旋劈裂态（Δ(Γ)≠0）或d波交错磁（altermagnetic）态（Δ(Γ)=0），且自旋劈裂随声子振幅线性增长并随位移方向反转而反转。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁体中的非相对论自旋劈裂（NRSS）可实现无磁化的自旋极化，适用于超快自旋电子学。然而，如何动态地、可选择性地调控NRSS的不同相位（如s波与d波交错磁态）仍是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 利用对称性分析确定Γ点红外活性声子模式对自旋简并的解除机制及其与剩余亚晶格连接对称性的关系；结合第一性原理计算，以MnPS₃为模型材料，分别研究破坏全部亚晶格连接对称性的模式（诱导s波自旋劈裂）和保留镜像对称性的模式（诱导d波交错磁态），并考察声子振幅与位移方向对自旋劈裂的影响。
AI.result: 红外活性声子激发可解除基态自旋简并；不同红外模式耦合正交的面内光偏振，可通过驱动场偏振选择性地激活不同自旋劈裂相位。在MnPS₃中，破坏全部亚晶格连接对称性的模式产生s波自旋劈裂（Δ(Γ)≠0），保留镜像对称性的模式产生d波交错磁态（Δ(Γ)=0）。两种情况下自旋劈裂均随声子振幅线性变化，声子位移反转时诱导的自旋极化也随之反转。
AI.conclusion: 相干晶格驱动提供了一种直接、偏振选择性和模式选择性的动态诱导反铁磁体中不同NRSS相位的途径，为超快自旋电子学中无磁化的动态自旋调控开辟了新方向。

title: Magnons in Metallic Altermagnetic $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$
summary: We investigate the spin excitation in altermagnetic vanadium oxyselenides, focusing on the metallic quasi-two-dimensional compound $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$. Using a fermionic Hamiltonian derived from ab initio calculations, we compute the transverse spin susceptibilities within the random phase approximation and extract the magnon dispersion relation. We show that the altermagnetic symmetry leads to characteristic degeneracies and directional splittings in both the electronic bands and the magnon spectra along high-symmetry paths of the Brillouin zone. The metallic $\text{KV}_2\text{Se}_2\text{O}$ exhibits finite magnon linewidths arising from the coupling to the particle-hole continuum. Furthermore, by fixing the magnitude of the wave vector and varying its in-plane direction, we uncover a pronounced angular dependence of the magnon energies and lifetimes, with complementary damping behavior between the two magnon branches. Upon including spin-orbit coupling, the system exhibits an out-of-plane easy c-axis anisotropy, which opens a magnon gap of approximately 6 meV at the $Γ$-point, possibly rendering the magnetic order stable at room temperature. Our results demonstrate that altermagnetism controls not only the dispersion but also the anisotropic decay of spin excitations, highlighting altermagnetic metals as promising platforms for directionally selective magnon transport.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了交变磁性金属化合物KV₂Se₂O中的自旋激发行为。通过从头算得到的费米子哈密顿量，利用随机相位近似计算横向自旋磁化率并提取磁振子色散关系。研究发现交变磁性对称性导致电子能带和磁振子谱沿高对称路径出现特征性的简并和方向性劈裂，且金属性导致磁振子线宽变宽（与粒子-空穴连续谱耦合）。磁振子能量和寿命对角方向表现出强烈依赖，两个磁振子支具有互补的阻尼行为。加入自旋轨道耦合后产生面外易c轴各向异性，在Γ点打开约6 meV的磁振子能隙，可能使磁序在室温下保持稳定。研究表明交变磁性不仅控制色散还控制自旋激发的各向异性衰减，交变磁性金属是方向选择性磁振子输运的理想平台。
AI.motivation: 交变磁性（altermagnetism）是一种介于铁磁和反铁磁之间的新型磁性序，具有零净磁化但能带劈裂等独特性质。此前对交变磁体的研究大多集中于绝缘体，而对其金属相中的自旋激发行为特别是磁振子动力学了解甚少。作者希望探索交变磁性对称性如何影响金属化合物中磁振子的色散、阻尼和各向异性衰减，以评估其在方向选择性磁振子输运应用中的潜力。
AI.method: 作者以金属准二维化合物KV₂Se₂O为研究对象，采用以下方法：（1）基于从头算（ab initio）导出一个费米子哈密顿量；（2）在随机相位近似（RPA）框架内计算横向自旋磁化率；（3）从自旋磁化率极点提取磁振子色散关系和寿命；（4）通过固定波矢模长并改变面内方向来揭示磁振子能量和寿命的角向依赖；（5）进一步引入自旋轨道耦合（SOC）研究其对磁晶各向异性和磁振子能隙的影响。
AI.result: （1）交变磁性对称性在电子能带和磁振子谱中均产生特征性的方向性劈裂和简并模式；（2）粒子-空穴连续谱耦合导致磁振子拥有有限线宽；（3）磁振子能量和寿命显示强烈角向各向异性，两个磁振子支具有互补的阻尼行为；（4）自旋轨道耦合引入面外易c轴各向异性，在Γ点打开约6 meV的磁振子能隙，可能使磁序在室温下稳定。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明交变磁性不仅控制磁振子的色散关系，还控制其各向异性的衰减动力学，这为交变磁性金属作为方向选择性磁振子输运和自旋电子学器件的候选材料提供了坚实的理论支撑。

title: Observation of g-wave altermagnetic multipole
summary: Over the past few years, altermagnets have emerged as a new class of collinear magnets with broken time-reversal symmetry, offering novel opportunities for spintronics beyond conventional magnets. Rather than from net magnetization, as in ferromagnets, the unconventional time-reversal symmetry breaking of altermagnets originates from antiferroic magnetic dipoles locked to higher-order multipoles. Here we report the direct visualization of a $g$-wave altermagnetic multipole in the canonical altermagnet CrSb. Combining high-energy synchrotron X-ray diffraction with valence electron density (VED) analysis, we uncover a pronounced directional anisotropy of the VED distribution alternating between Cr sublattices. This evidences the antiferroic order of electric hexadecapoles predicted in $g$-wave altermagnets. Its coexistence with antiferroic magnetic dipoles induces ferroic magnetic multipoles, as probed by polarized neutron diffraction. We further identify a microscopic model of altermagnetism that directly relates the $g$-wave multipole and the $g$-wave spin splitting. Through direct observation and quantification of multipoles, this study provides a real-space fingerprint of altermagnetism and establishes a general probe of hidden multipole order in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高能同步辐射X射线衍射结合价电子密度分析，在典型交错磁体CrSb中直接可视化观测了g波交错磁多极子（电十六极子），并利用极化中子衍射证实其与反铁磁磁偶极子共存产生铁性磁多极子，为交错磁性提供了实空间指纹和通用探测方法。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体（altermagnets）作为一种新型共线磁体类别，具有破缺时间反演对称性，为超越传统磁体的自旋电子学提供新机遇。然而，交错磁性源自锁定到高阶多极子的反铁磁性磁偶极子，而非净磁化强度，直接观测这些隐藏的多极子序一直缺乏有效手段。
AI.method: 结合高能同步辐射X射线衍射与价电子密度（VED）分析，揭示CrSublattice之间VED分布交替变化的方向各向异性；利用极化中子衍射探测多极子；并建立微观模型联系g波多极子与g波自旋劈裂。
AI.result: 在CrSb中直接可视化g波交错磁电十六极子，证实了反铁性电十六极子序的存在；发现其与反铁磁性磁偶极子共存时可诱导铁性磁多极子；建立了联系g波多极子与g波自旋劈裂的微观模型。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过对多极子的直接观测与定量分析，为交错磁性提供了实空间指纹特征，并建立了量子材料中隐藏多极子序的通用探测方法。

title: Latent unified smooth Hamiltonians for excited state chemistry
comment: 24 pages main, 7 pages supplement, 4 figures main, 6 figures supplement, 2 tables supplement
summary: We describe a neural network architecture and training procedure designed to model electronic ground and excited states of arbitrary molecular systems. By indirectly learning a latent, implicit basis representation of the electronic-state Hamiltonian, the model offers a unified treatment of multiple electronic states, conical intersections, and non-adiabatic couplings. The formalism can be further extended to learn consistent latent representations of additional operators such as transition dipole moments, for example. To demonstrate the general capabilities of our architecture, we train and evaluate networks on two realistic photochemical systems, thymine and azobenzene. The resulting models accurately reproduce energies and oscillator strengths for the ground- and low-lying excited states relevant to the photochemistry of these systems. We highlight the performance of the trained networks by studying critical molecular geometries, including conical intersections and excited state minima. By construction, the proposed framework also recovers the emergence of Berry phase accumulation around conical intersections. By pairing key mathematical structure from quantum chemistry with the representation learning power of transformers, the presented architecture offers a qualitatively new path toward fast and accurate ground- and excited-state simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于Transformer的神经网络架构与训练流程，用于建模任意分子体系的电子基态与激发态。通过间接学习电子态哈密顿量的隐式基底表示，该模型统一处理多个电子态、锥形交叉和非绝热耦合，并可扩展学习跃迁偶极矩等额外算符。在胸腺嘧啶和偶氮苯两个光化学体系上验证，模型能准确复现基态与低激发态的能量及振子强度，并正确处理锥形交叉、激发态极小值及Berry相积累。
AI.motivation: 传统量子化学方法计算激发态（尤其是含锥形交叉和非绝热耦合的多电子态问题）成本高昂，难以扩展到实际光化学体系的大规模模拟。现有机器学习势能面方法多聚焦单一电子态，缺乏对多态耦合与拓扑性质的统一建模能力。
AI.method: 提出一种神经网络架构，通过间接学习电子态哈密顿量的潜在隐式基底表示，使模型能够统一描述多个电子态。利用Transformer的表征学习能力捕捉量子化学中的数学结构，并将框架扩展至跃迁偶极矩等附加算符，实现对锥形交叉与非绝热耦合的建模。
AI.result: 在胸腺嘧啶和偶氮苯两个真实光化学体系中，模型准确复现基态与低激发态的能量和振子强度，并成功描述锥形交叉、激发态极小值等关键分子几何结构，同时天然恢复锥形交叉周围的Berry相积累。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将量子化学的关键数学结构与Transformer的表征学习能力相结合，为快速精确的基态与激发态模拟提供了全新途径，有望推动光化学动力学的机器学习建模发展。

title: Vortex-core Majorana coupling to a chiral edge in a $p_x+ip_y$ superconductor: Nonmonotonic spectral reorganization and coherent fermion-parity dynamics
summary: We study how vortex--edge coupling reorganizes the low-energy sector of a finite two-dimensional \(p_x+ip_y\) superconducting disk as a function of the vortex--boundary separation \(d\) and examine what this reorganization implies for the parity memory associated with a prescribed vortex-core Majorana wave packet, a resource relevant to Majorana-based quantum operations. Bogoliubov--de Gennes calculations reveal nonmonotonic core--edge reorganization of the lowest positive-energy finite-disk eigenstate, with particularly rapid variation near \(d\simeq7ξ\), where \(ξ\) is the coherence length. To separate this eigenstate reorganization from the spectral representation of a prescribed state, we rigidly translate a centered-vortex core-reference packet to each fixed vortex position, restrict it to the target disk, and project it, without intermediate normalization, onto the particle-hole-complete low-energy subspace. For \(Δ_0/E_F=0.36\) and disk radius \(R=30ξ\), the resulting retained norm exceeds \(0.98\) at all six sampled separations, \(4.25\leq d/ξ\leq8.25\), while, depending on \(d\), the spectral measure is concentrated near zero energy, fragmented over several low-energy levels, or dominated by finite-energy weight. Correspondingly, the signed parity correlator displays slow temporal variation, rapid coherent dephasing, or sign-changing oscillations, with possible finite-size recurrences at later times. Thus a large retained norm does not by itself imply spectral concentration or persistent parity memory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限二维p_x+ip_y超导圆盘中涡旋-边界耦合如何随涡旋-边界距离d重组低能态，并分析了这种重组对涡旋核心马约拉纳波包奇偶性记忆的影响。BdG计算显示在d≈7ξ处出现快速的非单调核心-边界重组；通过刚性平移参考波包并投影到低能子空间，在六种间距下保留范数均超过0.98，但谱度量分布随d变化极大——从集中于零能到碎片化甚至由有限能量主导，对应的奇偶性关联子表现为缓慢时间演化、快速相干退相或符号振荡。结论指出大保留范数并不必然意味着谱集中或持久的奇偶性记忆。
AI.motivation: 马约拉纳零模是实现拓扑量子计算的关键资源，其奇偶性记忆依赖于涡旋核心态与连续态/边界态的耦合方式。理解涡旋-边界耦合如何重组低能谱结构，以及这是否影响预设马约拉纳波包的相干性与记忆持久性，对于评估真实器件中马约拉纳量子操作的可靠性至关重要。
AI.method: 采用Bogoliubov-de Gennes (BdG)计算分析有限二维p_x+ip_y超导圆盘的最低正能本征态随涡旋-边界距离d的重组行为。为分离本征态重组与预设态的谱表示，作者将中心涡旋核心参考波包刚性平移到各固定涡旋位置，限制到目标圆盘后无中间归一化地投影到粒子-空穴完备低能子空间，并计算保留范数、谱度量和奇偶性关联子的时间演化。
AI.result: 在Δ0/EF=0.36、盘半径R=30ξ的参数下，所有六个采样间距(4.25≤d/ξ≤8.25)的保留范数均超过0.98。然而谱度量表现出三种不同行为：集中于近零能量、碎片化分布多个低能级、或由有限能量权重主导。相应的奇偶性关联子分别呈现缓慢时间变化、快速相干退相、或变号振荡，后期可能出现有限尺寸回波。
AI.conclusion: 大规模的保留范数（投影保真度高）并不足以保证谱集中或持久的奇偶性记忆。涡旋-边界距离d显著影响低能谱的重新分布和奇偶性记忆的持续时间，这对马约拉纳量子操作的实际实现提出了重要的设计约束——即使核心态能有效保留在低能子空间内，其相干性和记忆保持也可能因谱结构重组而受损。

title: Branching stochastic mechanics. II. Relative localization and collective poles from Bohm/Fisher feedback
summary: Paper I introduced branching stochastic mechanics (BSM) by lifting the Schrödinger-Nagasawa pair to reciprocal forward and backward branching fields. Their centered connected kernel $C_{\rm FB}=\mathbb E_ω[ψ_Fψ_B]$ carries the organized reciprocal sector, where $\mathbb E_ω$ denotes expectation over branching-noise realizations, with $ρ_{\rm BSM}=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)$ on the anticorrelated branch. Here we develop the stochastic field theory of the Bohm/Fisher feedback that acts on this connected sector. Starting from the multiplicative branching covariance of BSM, a Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) formulation and a causal two-loop two-particle-irreducible (2PI) closure are used to determine response and correlation functions self-consistently. The free connected theory exhibits secular growth and ultraviolet accumulation, whereas the dressed theory develops a finite relative screening length. A reduced numerical evolution shows bounded formation of this localized sector, and a self-similar Fisher construction defines the saturated information velocity $c_\star$. A Born-Oppenheimer separation then distinguishes internal relative organization from collective propagation. Restoring the complete frequency structure gives two fixed-$q$ pole families: a gapless difference branch and a gapped sum branch. The infrared velocity of the difference branch approaches $c_\star$ at saturation. The common cone and the projected sum-sector gap are then formulated as additional fixed-point matching conditions for the collective theory.

AI.tldr: 本文进一步发展了分支随机力学(BSM)的随机场论。通过Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de Dominicis (MSRJD)形式和因果的双圈2PI闭合方法，研究了作用于连通扇区的Bohm/Fisher反馈。自由连通理论呈现长期增长和紫外累积，而重整化理论发展出有限的相对屏蔽长度。约化数值演化展示了局域扇区的有界形成，自相似Fisher构造定义了饱和信息速度c★。恢复完整频率结构后得到两支固定q极点族：无能隙差支和有隙和支，差支的红外速度在饱和时趋于c★。
AI.motivation: 论文I引入了分支随机力学(BSM)将薛定谔-长泽对提升为互反的前向和后向分支场，其中心连通核携带了有组织的互反扇区。本文的动机在于：此前的工作仅建立了该框架，尚未发展出能够自洽描述Bohm/Fisher反馈作用的随机场论，因此需要一套系统的场论工具来理解这一局域化组织的动力学机制。
AI.method: 从BSM的乘法分支协方差出发，采用MSRJD形式体系构建响应函数框架，并利用因果双圈2PI闭合方法自洽地确定响应函数和关联函数。通过对比自由连通理论与重整化(dressed)理论的差异，并结合约化数值演化与自相似Fisher构造，论文还采用Born-Oppenheimer分离将内部相对组织与集体传播区分开来，最终通过恢复完整频率结构来分析极点结构。
AI.result: 自由连通理论表现出长期(secular)增长和紫外累积的病理行为，而受到Bohm/Fisher反馈重整的理论则发展出有限的相对屏蔽长度。约化数值演化证实了局域扇区的有界形成。极点分析揭示了两支固定q极点族：无"gap"的差分支和有"gap"的和分支，差分支在饱和时红外速度趋于c★。并进一步将公共锥和投影和扇区gap表述为集体理论的固定点匹配条件。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个完整自洽的BSM随机场论框架，证明Bohm/Fisher反馈能将原本病态的自由理论重整为具有有限屏蔽长度和饱和信息速度c★的局域组织理论。两支极点家族的结构（差支无色散gap、和支有gap）结合Born-Oppenheimer分离，为理解量子力学中的内部相对组织与集体传播的耦合提供了新的理论工具，公共锥与和扇区gap的固定点匹配条件则为集体理论的进一步闭合指明了方向。

title: RBMD 2.0: Random batch molecular dynamics package for large-scale simulations on multi-GPU architectures
summary: Large-scale molecular dynamics simulations of particle systems on multi-GPU architectures are often constrained by the computational and communication costs of nonbonded force evaluation. We present RBMD 2.0, a major new release of the random batch molecular dynamics package designed for cross-node multi-GPU simulations of large-scale systems. It combines the improved random batch Ewald method with three-dimensional domain decomposition and ghost-particle communication to accelerate multi-GPU nonbonded force evaluation, while the DTK CUDA framework facilitates portability across heterogeneous accelerator architectures. Numerical experiments on multiple benchmark systems demonstrate both the accuracy and efficiency of simulations with RBMD 2.0. For simulations involving up to hundreds of millions of particles across multiple accelerator devices, one achieves speedups ranging from severalfold to approximately two orders of magnitude in nonbonded force evaluation while exhibiting over $97.5\%$ weak-scaling behavior. These results demonstrate the promising nature of RBMD 2.0 as a computational engine for future exascale molecular dynamics simulations.

AI.tldr: RBMD 2.0是一个面向跨节点多GPU大规模分子动力学模拟的开源软件包，融合改进的随机批Ewald方法与三维域分解及虚粒子通信技术，结合DTK CUDA框架实现异构加速器上的可移植性。在多达数亿粒子的多设备模拟中，非键力计算提速数倍至约两个数量级，弱扩展性超过97.5%，展现出迈向百亿亿次分子动力学模拟引擎的潜力。
AI.motivation: 大规模多GPU架构上的分子动力学模拟常受限于非键力评估的计算与通信开销，现有方案难以兼顾准确性与跨节点扩展效率，亟需一种在异构多GPU平台上高效、准确且可扩展的分子动力学模拟工具。
AI.method: 将改进的随机批Ewald方法（RBEM）与三维域分解和虚粒子通信相结合，以加速多GPU上的非键力评估；同时利用DTK CUDA框架实现跨异构加速器架构的可移植性。
AI.result: 在多个基准系统上，针对多达数亿粒子的多加速器模拟，非键力评估实现数倍到约两个数量级的加速，同时保持超过97.5%的弱扩展性能。
AI.conclusion: RBMD 2.0在准确性、效率和多GPU扩展性方面均表现出色，有望成为未来百亿亿次（exascale）分子动力学模拟的核心计算引擎。

title: Molecular spin qubits in a van der Waals bottle
summary: Advancing quantum information technologies requires qubits whose coherence can be precisely engineered. Among the qubit platforms in development, molecular spin qubits (MSQs) stand out for their atomic scale tunability and chemical specificity, making them powerful candidates for sensing, simulation, and information processing. However, integrating MSQs into solid-state architectures without degrading their coherence remains a central challenge. Here, we introduce van der Waals (vdW) confinement within two-dimensional materials as a strategy for stabilizing quantum states in MSQs by engineering their local electronic, vibrational, and symmetry environments. Using cobaltocene as a model system, we show that confinement within vdW SnS2 and CdPS3 single crystals reorganizes the single-ion energy landscape and slows spin-lattice relaxation by over two orders of magnitude relative to unconfined cobaltocene. The confined MSQs adopt deterministic orientations and self-assemble into ordered, atomically precise superlattices, establishing vdW confinement as a pathway for integrating MSQs into functional quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用二维材料中的范德华（vdW）限域策略来稳定分子自旋量子比特（MSQs）的量子态。以钴茂（cobaltocene）为模型系统，将其限域在SnS2和CdPS3单晶中，通过工程化其局部电子、振动和对称环境，使自旋-晶格弛豫比未限域的钴茂减慢两个数量级以上。限域的MSQs呈现确定性取向并自组装成原子级精确的超晶格，为将MSQs集成到功能量子器件中提供了新路径。
AI.motivation: 分子自旋量子比特（MSQs）具有原子尺度可调性和化学特异性，是传感、模拟和信息处理的强有力候选者，但将其集成到固态架构中而不降低其相干性仍是一个核心挑战。
AI.method: 提出vdW限域策略——将MSQs限域在层状二维材料（SnS2和CdPS3）的范德华间隙中，通过工程化局部电子、振动和对称环境来稳定量子态。
AI.result: 限域使自旋-晶格弛豫比未限域钴茂减慢两个数量级以上；限域MSQs采用确定性取向并自组装成有序、原子级精确的超晶格。
AI.conclusion: vdW限域可作为将MSQs集成到功能量子器件中的有效途径，同时保持其相干性并实现精确空间排列。

title: Complete Topological Classification with P and T Symmetries: Revealing a Topological Invariant Invisible to K-Theory
summary: The K-theoretic framework provides a complete topological classification of the tenfold symmetry classes and has been generalized to incorporate crystalline symmetries. Here, we show that this classification is incomplete even in the elementary case of spinless systems possessing both P and T symmetries. We obtain the complete classification through a first-principles analysis of the topological classes of P- and T-symmetric bands, namely, by classifying the corresponding symmetric clutching data. We identify a topological invariant that is invisible from the K-theoretic perspective when the occupied states at each inversion-invariant momentum have uniformly positive or uniformly negative parity. In special cases, such as when all inversion-invariant momenta have uniformly positive parity, this invariant can be interpreted as the second Stiefel--Whitney class or the Euler number defined over an inversion fundamental domain, namely, half of the Brillouin zone. Our work not only reveals a new topological invariant that cannot be determined from the parity spectra at inversion-invariant momenta under P and T symmetries, but also demonstrates the existence of crystalline topological phases that are absent from the K-theoretic classification.

AI.tldr: 本文指出K-理论框架对拓扑分类的不完备性，即使在同时具有P和T对称性的无自旋系统这一基本情形下也存在被遗漏的拓扑不变量。作者通过对称衔接数据(first-principles分析)获得了完整分类，发现了一个K-理论视角无法揭示的拓扑不变量，并证明存在K-理论分类之外的晶体拓扑相。
AI.motivation: K-理论框架虽已被广泛用于十种对称类的拓扑分类并推广至晶体对称性，但作者发现即使在最基础的同时具有P和T对称性的无自旋系统中，该分类仍不完备，存在K-理论无法捕捉的拓扑不变量和拓扑相。
AI.method: 作者从第一性原理出发，对具有P和T对称性的能带拓扑类进行分类，具体方法是对称衔接数据(symmetric clutching data)进行分类；并通过倒空间分析在特殊条件下将所发现的新不变量解释为定义在倒空间反转基本域（半个布里渊区）上的第二Stiefel-Whitney类或Euler数。
AI.result: 作者识别出一个K-理论视角不可见的拓扑不变量，该不变量出现在反转不变动量点处占据态宇称均匀为正或均匀为负的情形中；在特殊情形（如所有反转不变动量点宇称均匀为正）下可解释为第二Stiefel-Whitney类或Euler数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了无法仅通过反转不变动量点处的宇称谱确定的新的拓扑不变量，并证明了存在K-理论分类之外的晶体拓扑相，说明现有K-理论方法需要补充或扩展才能完备描述晶体拓扑分类。

title: Thermodynamic Electric Toroidal Dipole and Intrinsic Longitudinal Spin Transport
summary: Electric toroidal dipoles (ETDs) characterize ferroaxial order, yet their bulk definition in periodic crystals has remained elusive because conventional multipole operators involve the ill-defined position operator. Here we formulate a thermodynamic ETD by coupling a spatially varying electric field to the relativistic spin-induced electric polarization. The resulting expression is gauge invariant and provides a bulk order parameter for ferroaxial phases. We further establish a direct relation between the chemical-potential derivative of the ETD and the intrinsic longitudinal spin conductivity in insulating systems. To demonstrate the formulation, we construct a minimal ferroaxial extension of the Kane--Mele model. The ETD becomes finite exclusively in the ferroaxial phase and is strongly enhanced near a small band gap, accompanied by a sizable longitudinal spin current. Our results establish a thermodynamic theory of ETDs in crystalline solids and identify the longitudinal spin conductivity as a direct transport manifestation of ferroaxial order.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将空间变化的电场与相对论性自旋诱导电极化耦合，提出了周期性晶体中电子环向偶极矩（ETD）的热力学定义，该定义满足规范不变性，可作为铁轴向序的体有序参量，并建立了ETD与纵向自旋电导率之间的直接联系。
AI.motivation: 电子环向偶极矩刻画铁轴向序，但在周期性晶体中缺乏体定义，因为传统多极算符涉及定义不清的位置算符。这阻碍了对铁轴向相的系统研究和表征。
AI.method: 作者通过将空间变化电场与相对论性自旋诱导电极化耦合来构造热力学ETD，得到规范不变的体表达式；随后推导了绝缘系统中ETD对化学势的导数与固有纵向自旋电导率的关系，并构造了Kane-Mele模型的铁轴向扩展模型进行验证。
AI.result: ETD仅在铁轴向相中为非零值，并在小带隙附近显著增强，伴随可观的纵向自旋电流。该结果验证了所提出的热力学理论的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了晶体中电子环向偶极矩的热力学理论，并确定了纵向自旋电导率可作为铁轴向序的直接输运体现，为铁轴向材料的实验探测提供了新的途径。

title: A Generalized Approach for Incorporating Geometry and Directionality into Coarse-Grained Machine-Learned Potentials
summary: Machine-learned interatomic potentials have enabled highly accurate atomistic simulations, but extending these capabilities to coarse-grained systems remains challenging due to the loss of geometric and orientational information during coarse-graining. In this work, we present a generalized framework for incorporating molecular geometry and directionality into coarse-grained machine-learned potentials through two complementary approaches: anisotropic density-based descriptors (AniSOAP) and symmetry-adapted equivariant message-passing neural networks (MACE-CG). Using Gay-Berne particles and coarse-grained representations of benzene, formamide, and water, we demonstrate that explicitly retaining molecular anisotropy substantially improves the prediction of energies, forces, and torques relative to isotropic representations. AniSOAP provides an effective linear baseline when molecular shape is well approximated by ellipsoidal symmetry, while symmetry-adapted MACE-CG enables the incorporation of arbitrary molecular point-group symmetries. For water, whose orientational degrees of freedom are poorly represented by ellipsoidal descriptors alone, symmetry-adapted rigid-body features improve energy, force, and torque prediction by resolving orientational degeneracies inherent to isotropic and moment-of-inertia-based representations. These results show that information loss in coarse-grained modeling is governed not only by mapping resolution but also by the symmetry and geometric information retained in the representation, providing a systematic route toward more expressive and transferable coarse-grained machine-learned potentials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用框架，通过两种互补方法（各向异性密度描述符AniSOAP和对称适配等变消息传递神经网络MACE-CG）将分子几何和方向性信息纳入粗粒化机器学习势能中，显著提高了能量、力和扭矩预测精度。
AI.motivation: 机器学习原子间势能已实现高精度原子模拟，但扩展到粗粒化系统时，由于粗粒化过程中几何和方向信息的丢失而面临挑战。需要系统性方法在粗粒化表示中保留分子各向异性和对称性信息。
AI.method: 提出两种互补方法：(1) AniSOAP——各向异性密度基描述符；(2) MACE-CG——对称适配等变消息传递神经网络。两者共同将分子几何和方向性纳入粗粒化势能。测试系统包括Gay-Berne粒子和苯、甲酰胺、水的粗粒化表示。
AI.result: 显式保留分子各向异性显著改善了能量、力和扭矩预测。AniSOAP在分子形状接近椭球对称时是有效的线性基线，而MACE-CG可纳入任意分子点群对称性。对水分子，对称适配刚体特征通过解决各向同性和惯性矩表示中的取向简并性，改善了预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 粗粒化建模中的信息损失不仅取决于映射分辨率，还取决于表示中保留的对称性和几何信息。这为构建更具表达力和可迁移性的粗粒化机器学习势能提供了系统性路径。

title: Anomalous Superfluid Response in Altermagnetic Superconductors
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures; suggestions for overlooked references are welcome
summary: We report on the emergence of the anomalous (paramagnetic) superfluid response in altermagnetic superconductors at arbitrary impurity concentrations. Due to anisotropic gapless superconductivity, altermagnetic superconductors with an out-of-plane Zeeman field display an anisotropic paramagnetic Meissner effect. The effect is strongest for parallel altermagnetic and Zeeman exchange field vectors and in the clean sample. The presence of nonmagnetic impurities leads to isotropisation and, consequently, weakens the effect; however, the paramagnetic response sustains intermediate amounts of impurities in the system. As demonstrated in recent experiments, microwave superfluid stiffness measurements can serve as a sensitive probe of gapless superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了交变磁超导体中异常（顺磁）超流体响应的涌现，发现即使存在任意杂质浓度，该顺磁迈斯纳效应依然存在，但非磁性杂质会使其各向同性化并削弱该效应。
AI.motivation: 交变磁超导体作为一种新兴的超导系统，其各向异性无隙超导特性可能导致传统迈斯纳效应的反常行为，理解这一现象对于揭示其物理本质和实验探测至关重要。
AI.method: 理论上分析了交变磁超导体在面外塞曼场作用下，平行与非平行交变磁与塞曼交换场矢量配置下的超流体响应，并考察了不同杂质浓度（从纯净到中等杂质）的影响。
AI.result: 交变磁超导体表现出各向异性的顺磁迈斯纳效应，在平行磁场配置和纯净样品中效应最强；非磁性杂质导致各向同性化并削弱效应，但中等杂质浓度下顺磁响应仍可持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 顺磁超流体响应可在任意杂质浓度下存在于交变磁超导体中，且微波超流体刚度测量可作为探测这种无隙超导性的灵敏实验工具。

title: Memory-driven Topological Defects and Unconventional Long-Range Order
summary: We investigate many-body systems with time-delayed self-interactions mediated by a memory-feedback mechanism. We show that such temporal interactions generate non-equilibrium orders and unique topological defects absent in equilibrium-specifically, helical vortices wherein opposite vorticities propagate in reverse directions along domain walls. In one dimension, memory feedback stabilizes true long-range order against weak noise, thereby circumventing the Mermin-Wagner theorem and resulting in an unconventional finite-temperature phase transition with a dynamical exponent $z = 4$. Physical realizations of these memory-driven non-equilibrium systems using active mechatronic metamaterials has also been proposed. These results demonstrate engineered temporal interactions as a powerful paradigm for non-equilibrium many-body physics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了由记忆反馈机制介导的含时延自相互作用的多体系统，发现这类时间性相互作用能产生平衡态中不存在的非平衡有序和独特拓扑缺陷（螺旋涡旋）。在一维系统中，记忆反馈能在弱噪声下稳定真正的长程有序，绕过了Mermin-Wagner定理的限制，产生了具有动力学指数z=4的非常规有限温度相变。作者还提出了利用主动机械超材料实现这些系统的方案，展示了工程化时间相互作用作为非平衡多体物理的强大范例。
AI.motivation: 探索超越传统平衡态系统的非平衡多体物理，特别是通过记忆反馈机制引入时间延迟相互作用，研究其能否产生新的物理现象（如非平衡有序态、独特拓扑缺陷等），这些现象在平衡系统中不存在或难以实现。
AI.method: 采用理论分析方法研究含时延自相互作用的多体系统，通过记忆反馈机制建模时间性相互作用；分析系统的有序参数、拓扑缺陷结构及相变行为（包括动力学指数z=4的确定）；并提出利用主动机械超材料（mechatronic metamaterials）进行物理实验实现的方案。
AI.result: 发现时间延迟相互作用可产生非平衡有序态和独特的螺旋涡旋拓扑缺陷（相反涡度的涡旋沿畴壁反向传播）；在一维系统中，记忆反馈可在弱噪声下维持真正的长程有序，突破Mermin-Wagner定理限制，形成具有动力学指数z=4的非常规有限温度相变。
AI.conclusion: 记忆驱动的非平衡系统为实现工程化动力学相互作用提供了新的范式，时间相互作用可作为探索非平衡多体物理的强大工具，为未来在超材料和其它物理平台中实现丰富的非平衡现象开辟了新途径。

title: Learning Spectral-Like Mesh-Free Discretisations
summary: Meshfree methods such as smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) with kernel corrections, radial basis function-generated finite differences (RBF-FD), and the local anisotropic basis function method (LABFM) construct discrete differential operators by imposing polynomial consistency on a local stencil. For stencils containing more nodes than there are consistency constraints, the resulting linear system is underdetermined, and the remaining degrees of freedom are fixed implicitly by the choice of kernel, basis preconditioning, or a minimum-norm condition. Polynomial consistency constrains the operator only in the low-wavenumber limit, and no part of the construction selects for accuracy at the wavenumbers where fine-scale content resides. We introduce Spectral-like Neural Discretisation (SpeND), in which the choice of those degrees of freedom is cast as a learning problem: stencil weights are parametrised by a neural network conditioned on the local node geometry, trained to approximate the modal response of a spectral operator over the resolvable band. A hard-constrained projection layer maps the network output onto the affine subspace of consistent weights, so that polynomial consistency holds exactly by construction rather than as a penalty. Training is self-supervised and physics-agnostic, requiring no reference solutions; the objective minimises dispersion and dissipation error over a prescribed band-limited function space. Modal analysis on disordered two-dimensional node distributions shows that the learned fourth-order operator follows the exact response over a substantially wider band than either explicit LABFM at equal stencil size or fourth-order finite differences on a structured grid, whilst recovering the expected fourth-order convergence rate under refinement.

AI.tldr: 提出了SpeND（Spectral-like Neural Discretisation），一种将无网格离散算子的自由度过拟合从隐式隐式的选择转化为可学习的神经网络问题的方法。该方法通过硬约束投影层保证多项式一致性严格成立，通过自监督训练最小化谱误差，在学习算子中实现了比传统方法更宽的精确频带和四阶收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有的无网格方法（如带有核修正的SPH、RBF-FD、LABFM）通过局部模板上的多项式一致性约束构造离散微分算子。当模板节点数多于一致性约束数时，线性系统欠定，剩余自由度由核函数、基预条件或最小范数条件隐式决定。然而多项式一致性仅在低波数极限下约束算子，构造过程没有针对精细尺度内容所在波数（中高波数）频段的精度进行选择，导致中高频响应误差较大。
AI.method: 将散节点上构造微分算子的欠定自由度选择问题转化为学习问题。核心要点：(1) 以局部节点几何为条件，用神经网络参数化模板权重；(2) 引入硬约束投影层，把网络输出映射到满足多项式一致性的仿射子空间上，使一致性作为精确约束而非惩罚项；(3) 采用自监督、与物理无关的训练，目标函数在限带函数空间上最小化色散与耗散误差（逼近谱算子在可分辨频带内的模态响应）。
AI.result: 在无序二维节点分布上的模态分析表明，学习得到的四阶算子相比于同模板规模的显式LABFM以及结构化网格上的四阶有限差分，在显著更宽的频带内匹配精确（谱）响应；同时恢复预期四阶收敛率。
AI.conclusion: SpeND证明可以数据驱动地学习无网格离散算子的自由参数，在不牺牲多项式一致性和收敛阶的前提下，显著拓宽算子在中高波数段的准确性，为无网格方法的算子构造提供了新的可学习范式。

title: Morphology and Dynamics of Self-interstitial Clusters in Irradiated Nickel
summary: Self-interstitial atom (SIA) clustering is a key early step in radiation damage evolution in face-centered cubic (FCC) metals, governing defect transport, recombination, and the long-term microstructural response of irradiated alloys. We combine molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and high-speed (>1000 frames/s) in situ transmission electron microscopy (TEM) to investigate the structure, energetics, and migration dynamics of SIA clusters in FCC Ni. MD simulations show that interstitials initially form disordered dumbbell clusters that evolve into either sessile Frank loops or glissile perfect (prismatic) loops; the latter progressively reorganize into compact ordered configurations with increasing mobility. Direct construction of both loop types over a wide size range, validated against MD-relaxed structures, shows that perfect loops are thermodynamically favored over Frank loops for cluster sizes N greater than or equal to 14, where N is the number of SIAs, with the energetic advantage increasing with cluster size. Nevertheless, substantial kinetic barriers allow Frank loops to persist as metastable defects. For perfect loops, diffusion coefficients computed over N = 16 to 400 reveal a nearly size-independent migration barrier of approximately 0.02 eV, while the diffusion prefactor decreases approximately as N^(-0.54). Trajectory analysis reveals a non-rigid, row-wise relay mechanism in which the number of participating atoms increases systematically with loop size, accounting for much of the observed prefactor scaling. Sub-millisecond in situ TEM observations reveal intermittent loop motion at velocities higher than previously observed but still several orders of magnitude below the intrinsic mobilities predicted by MD, indicating migration through a heterogeneous energy landscape of mobile and pinned states.

AI.tldr: 本文结合分子动力学模拟和高帧率原位透射电镜，系统研究了FCC镍中自间隙原子团簇的结构、能量学与迁移动力学。研究发现完美棱柱位错环在N≥14时热力学上优于弗兰克环但受动力学势垒限制可亚稳存在；完美环迁移势垒~0.02 eV且与尺寸基本无关，扩散前因子随N^(-0.54)衰减，源于非刚体逐行接力机制。原位TEM观测到的间隙性环运动速度远低于MD预测的本征迁移率，表明实际迁移受非均匀能量景观（移动态与钉扎态）调控。
AI.motivation: 理解FCC金属中自间隙原子团簇的行为对辐射损伤演化至关重要，但其结构演化、热力学稳定性与迁移动力学机制尚不清晰，尤其是跨尺度（原子尺度到实验观测）的迁移行为差异缺乏定量解释。
AI.method: 结合两种互补手段：(1) 分子动力学模拟研究间隙团簇的形成、结构演化和扩散动力学，直接构建两种位错环并交叉验证；计算扩散系数、迁移势垒与前因子的尺寸依赖关系，并通过轨迹分析揭示迁移机制。(2) 高帧率（>1000帧/秒）原位透射电镜观测亚毫秒时间尺度的环运动。
AI.result: 发现N≥14时完美环在能量上优于弗兰克环，但弗兰克环因动力学势垒呈亚稳存在。完美环迁移势垒~0.02 eV几乎不依赖尺寸（N=16-400），但扩散前因子随N^(-0.54)下降，源于逐行接力机制中参与原子数随环尺寸增大。原位TEM观测到间歇性环运动，速度虽高于以往观测但仍比MD预测低多个数量级，说明实际迁移受移动态与钉扎态间非均匀能量景观控制。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为FCC金属中SIA团簇的演化提供了原子尺度到实验尺度的完整图像，揭示了尺寸依赖的扩散动力学机制与实验中显著的动力学减速现象，对理解辐照材料的微结构演化及预测建模具有重要价值。

title: Persistence and emergence of quantum defects through pressure-induced phase changes
summary: Extreme pressures can transform materials and their properties, but probing these in-situ is made challenging by the small sample volumes and access requirements demanded by diamond anvil cells. Quantum defects offer a route to local measurements under such conditions, yet their sensing performance can be dictated by pressure-induced changes in their own host material. On the other hand, pressure may also be harnessed as a tool to engineer and stabilize new quantum defects with emergent functionalities. Here, we demonstrate both aspects within a unified platform based on optically active spin-pair defects in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN). As robust quantum sensors under pressure, these spin-1/2 systems retain pressure-independent spin resonances up to 20 GPa while maintaining or even enhancing their optical emission, in stark contrast to the spin-1 boron-vacancy centre in the same material. Simultaneously, we show that compression acts as a means of quantum defect engineering: the starting hBN undergoes an irreversible transformation into wurtzite boron nitride (wBN), during which the defect landscape is reconfigured. Spin-pair sensors are seen to persist across this structural transition, however, depending on the starting material we also observe new, highly fluorescent defects in the wBN phase. These results establish spin-pair defects in boron nitride as pressure-resilient quantum sensors while highlighting high pressure itself as a versatile pathway for creating and tuning quantum emitters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了六方氮化硼（hBN）中的自旋对缺陷在极端压力下的量子传感性能，发现其在高达20 GPa的压力下保持与压力无关的自旋共振并维持甚至增强光学发射，同时压缩可驱动hBN不可逆转变为纤锌矿氮化硼（wBN），重新配置缺陷景观并产生新的高荧光缺陷。
AI.motivation: 金刚石压砧环境中的原位探测因样品体积小和通道限制而极具挑战性，量子缺陷可提供局部测量途径，但其传感性能常受压力导致的宿主材料变化影响；另一方面，压力本身可能作为工程工具来创造和稳定具有新功能的量子缺陷，作者希望在一个统一平台上同时探索这两个方面。
AI.method: 作者以六方氮化硼（hBN）中光学活性自旋对缺陷（自旋-1/2系统）为统一平台，在高达20 GPa的压力下测量其自旋共振和光学发射特性，并与同材料中的自旋-1硼空位中心进行对比；同时利用压缩驱动hBN向纤锌矿氮化硼（wBN）的不可逆相变，观察缺陷景观的重构和新缺陷的形成。
AI.result: 自旋对缺陷在高达20 GPa压力下保持压力无关的自旋共振，且光学发射得以维持甚至增强，这与同材料中自旋-1硼空位中心的表现形成鲜明对比；压缩驱动hBN不可逆转变为wBN，自旋对传感器在该结构转变中持续存在，且部分起始材料中在wBN相观察到新的高荧光缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 自旋对缺陷被确立为氮化硼中耐压的量子传感器，同时证明高压本身是创建和调控量子发射体的多功能途径，为极端条件下的量子探测和缺陷工程提供了新思路。

title: Prominent Dimensional Effects on High-order Harmonic Generation in Strongly Correlated Electron Systems
summary: Dimensionality strongly affects elementary excitations in correlated quantum materials, yet its impact on extreme nonlinear optical responses remains largely unexplored. Here, we combine high-harmonic generation (HHG) experiments on quasi-one-dimensional SrCuO$_2$ and quasi-two-dimensional Pr$_2$CuO$_4$ with nonequilibrium simulations of Hubbard models. We find a pronounced dimensional contrast: SrCuO$_2$ exhibits a robust plateau-like high-harmonic spectrum with weak temperature dependence, whereas Pr$_2$CuO$_4$ shows a monotonic decrease in harmonic yield and strong thermal suppression, especially at higher harmonics. The simulations qualitatively reproduce these trends and identify dimensionality-dependent doublon--holon dephasing, governed by spin--charge coupling, as their microscopic origin. These results establish dimensionality and spin--charge coupling as key control parameters for extreme nonlinear optical responses in correlated insulators.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对比准一维SrCuO₂和准二维Pr₂CuO₄的高次谐波产生实验与Hubbard模型非平衡模拟，揭示了维度对极端非线性光学响应的显著影响，并指出双空穴-空穴去相位（由自旋-电荷耦合控制）是维度差异的微观起源。
AI.motivation: 维度强烈影响关联量子材料中的基本激发，但其对极端非线性光学响应的影响尚未被充分探索。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究维度如何调控高次谐波产生等极端非线性过程。
AI.method: 将准一维SrCuO₂和准二维Pr₂CuO₄的高次谐波产生实验与Hubbard模型的非平衡模拟相结合，通过比较不同维度体系的光谱特征和温度依赖性来揭示维度效应。
AI.result: 发现显著的维度对比：SrCuO₂表现为稳健的类平台高次谐波谱且温度依赖性弱，而Pr₂CuO₄则呈现谐波产率单调下降和强烈的热抑制效应（尤其在高次谐波处）。模拟定性重现了这些趋势，并识别出由自旋-电荷耦合调控的、依赖维度的双空穴-空穴去相位是微观根源。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了维度和自旋-电荷耦合是关联绝缘体中极端非线性光学响应的关键控制参数，为理解维度在强关联体系非线性光学中的作用提供了新视角。

title: Biquaternion Algebra with Bilinear Multiplication: A General, Elegant, and Computationally Advantageous Framework for Relativistic Electronic Structure Calculations on CPUs and GPUs
summary: Quaternion algebra provides a natural representation of time-reversal-symmetric matrix structures in relativistic electronic-structure theory, whereas complementary time-reversal-antisymmetric structures extend this representation to complex quaternions, or biquaternions. Here, we explicitly exploit biquaternion algebra for fundamental objects, including operators, kinetically and magnetically balanced basis functions, and their expectation values, within a unified framework encompassing real, complex, and real quaternion subalgebras as special cases. To realize this framework computationally, we have developed HMATLIB, a biquaternion matrix library implemented within the ReSpect package for pure CPU and hybrid CPU/GPU execution. A key development is a bilinear algorithm for matrix-valued biquaternion multiplication that reduces the number of real matrix--matrix multiplications from 64 to 24 compared with the conventional component-wise approach, while the biquaternion representation effectively doubles the maximum accessible matrix dimension under the same 32-bit indexing constraint. Numerical benchmarks on modern CPU and GPU architectures demonstrate that the biquaternion formulation consistently outperforms its isomorphic complex-algebra counterpart. For the largest matrices reported, hybrid CPU/GPU execution accelerates bilinear matrix multiplication by approximately 5-8 times over pure CPU execution and matrix diagonalization by approximately 12 and 61 times relative to CPU oneAPI MKL and NVHPC OpenBLAS, respectively. These results establish biquaternion algebra as a general and computationally advantageous framework for modern relativistic electronic-structure calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实现了基于双四元数（biquaternion）代数的统一框架，用于相对论电子结构理论中的时间反演对称/反对称矩阵结构。开发了HMATLIB双四元数矩阵库（集成于ReSpect包），采用双线性算法将矩阵乘法从64次实矩阵乘法降至24次，并在CPU/GPU架构上验证了其性能优势，最大矩阵规模提升一倍，混合CPU/GPU执行加速5-8倍。
AI.motivation: 相对论电子结构理论需要处理时间反演对称的矩阵结构，四元数代数虽能自然表示这些结构，但时间反演反对称结构需要复数四元数（双四元数）来处理。目前缺少将双四元数代数系统性地用于相对论电子结构计算的统一框架与高效计算实现。
AI.method: 文章系统性地利用双四元数代数处理相对论电子结构理论中的基本对象（算符、动力学与磁平衡基函数及其期望值），构建涵盖实、复、实四元数作为特例的统一框架。开发了HMATLIB双四元数矩阵库，支持纯CPU和混合CPU/GPU执行。关键创新是双线性矩阵乘法算法，将所需的实矩阵乘法数量从64次减少到24次，同时双四元数表示在32位索引限制下使最大可访问矩阵维度翻倍。
AI.result: 数值基准测试表明，在现代CPU和GPU架构上，双四元数公式持续优于同构的复代数对应方法。对于最大矩阵，混合CPU/GPU执行使双线性矩阵乘法相比纯CPU加速约5-8倍；矩阵对角化相比CPU oneAPI MKL加速约12倍，相比NVHPC OpenBLAS加速约61倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明双四元数代数是现代相对论电子结构计算中通用且计算上有优势的框架，在算法效率和硬件利用方面均展现出显著优势。

title: Quantum Structural Renormalization and Anharmonic Stabilization of Superconductivity in P4/mmm YScH8
summary: The recent synthesis of P4/mmm-YScH$_{8}$ at 191.7 GPa with a superconducting critical temperature Tc of 113 K has attracted considerable interest in the study of ternary superhydrides. Here we systematically evaluate the effects of quantum and anharmonic motion of ions in P4/mmm-YScH$_{8}$ using the stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation (SSCHA). We find that these effects renormalize the crystal structure and lower the dynamical stability threshold pressure from $\sim$140 GPa to $\sim$84 GPa, a reduction of about 40%. Furthermore, neglecting these effects causes a significant overestimation of the $T_{c}$, for instance by $\sim$20 K at 190 GPa. Our prediction of $T_{c}$ at 190 GPa is 113 K ($μ^{*}$= 0.13), close to the experimental observation. Analysis of the phonon density of states and Eliashberg spectral function further reveals site-dependent contributions to superconductivity. These results establish that a consistent treatment of nuclear quantum motion and anharmonicity is essential for accurately predicting superconductivity in compressed ternary hydrides.

AI.tldr: 本文使用随机自洽谐波近似（SSCHA）系统评估了P4/mmm-YScH₈超氢化物中离子量子运动与非谐效应的影响，发现这些效应将动态稳定阈值压力从~140 GPa降至~84 GPa（降低约40%），同时消除了对超导临界温度Tc的显著高估（在190 GPa时约高估20 K），最终预测的Tc为113 K，与实验观测吻合。
AI.motivation: P4/mmm-YScH₈在191.7 GPa下被实验合成并测得Tc为113 K，引起了三元超氢化物研究的广泛兴趣。然而此前理论计算往往忽略核量子运动和非谐效应，可能导致结构稳定性与超导性质的预测出现偏差，因此需要对其影响进行系统评估。
AI.method: 采用随机自洽谐波近似（SSCHA）方法，系统地纳入核量子运动和非谐效应对晶体结构的重整化影响，重新评估动态稳定性阈值压力，并结合声子态密度与Eliashberg谱函数分析各原子的超导贡献，计算超导临界温度Tc。
AI.result: 量子与非谐效应将动态稳定阈值压力从~140 GPa降低至~84 GPa（降低约40%）；忽略这些效应会导致Tc被显著高估约20 K（在190 GPa时）；计入这些效应后预测Tc为113 K（μ*=0.13），接近实验观测值；声子态密度与Eliashberg谱函数分析揭示了不同格点对超导性的差异化贡献。
AI.conclusion: 一致地考虑核量子运动与非谐效应对于准确预测压缩三元氢化物的超导电性至关重要，该研究为三元超氢化物的理论描述提供了更为可靠的方法论基础。

title: Thermodynamic optimization of thermal landscapes and energy barriers in a Brownian heat engine
summary: Spatial temperature fields in Brownian heat engines are commonly prescribed \emph{a priori}, and the resulting transport and thermodynamic properties are then calculated. Here we formulate the complementary inverse-design problem: determining the temperature profile and barrier height that optimize a chosen thermodynamic objective. We consider an overdamped Brownian particle in a symmetric triangular periodic potential under a constant opposing load and derive the exact stationary current and probability density for an arbitrary bounded temperature field, $\Tc\le T(x)\le\Th$. In the quasistatic limit, the efficiency becomes an exact functional of two inverse-temperature integrals over the uphill and downhill branches. Its rigorous global maximum under the pointwise temperature bounds is $η_{\max}=1-\Tc/\Th$, attained uniquely, up to sets of measure zero, by the hot-uphill/cold-downhill piecewise-constant profile. At finite current, however, the optimization changes qualitatively because the current is determined jointly by the cycle affinity and a nonlocal transport resistance. We derive the exact functional gradient and the corresponding box-constrained optimality conditions, showing that the current- or power-maximizing profile generally differs from the quasistatic efficiency optimum. For any prescribed temperature field, the current-maximizing barrier satisfies an exact balance between the marginal gain in thermal rectification and the marginal increase in transport resistance, with the characteristic estimate $U_0^*\simeq T_{\rm act}$, where $T_{\rm act}^{-1}=(2/L)\int_0^{L/2}\dd x/T(x)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究布朗热机的逆向设计问题：不是给定温度场来推算输运性质，而是通过优化确定最优温度分布与势垒高度。作者在过阻尼对称三角周期势和恒定负载下推导出精确的稳态电流与概率密度，证明准静态极限下效率的全局最大值为1-Tc/Th，由热点上坡/冷点下坡的分段常数温度剖面唯一定实现。在有限电流下，优化问题本质上改变，作者推导出精确泛函梯度与最优性条件，并给出电流最大化势垒的平衡条件与特征估计。
AI.motivation: 传统布朗热机研究中温度场通常是预先指定的，然后才计算输运和热力学性质。本文提出互补的逆向设计问题：通过优化温度分布和势垒高度来最大化所选的热力学目标，填补了这一研究空白。
AI.method: 作者在过阻尼布朗粒子+对称三角周期势+恒定负载的物理模型中，推导任意有界温度场下的精确稳态电流和概率密度。在准静态极限中，效率被表达为逆温度积分的精确泛函，利用变分方法求全局最大值。在有限电流情形下，推导精确泛函梯度及箱约束最优性条件，分析电流/功率最大化剖面与准静态效率最优解的差异，并推导最优势垒高度的精确平衡条件。
AI.result: 准静态极限下效率的全局最大值为η_max=1-Tc/Th，由热点上坡/冷点下坡的分段常数温度剖面（几乎处处意义下）唯一定现。有限电流下的优化与准静态结果存在定性差异，因为电流由周期亲和力和非局域输运电阻共同决定。最优势垒满足热整流边际增益与输运电阻边际增加之间的精确平衡，特征估计为U0*≈T_act。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为布朗热机的逆向设计提供了严格的数学框架，揭示了准静态极限下效率最优的普适性上界（卡诺形式），同时指出有限电流情形下最优解的本质不同及最优势垒的通用估计，对微纳尺度热机的设计与优化具有指导意义。

title: A Wannier-first approach for extended chiral systems
summary: We present a real-space formulation of DFT for extended systems in which localized Wannier-like functions are constructed directly from localized Gaussian basis functions without explicitly computing canonical Bloch-like states during the self-consistent cycle. Building on the formalism of Pederson and Lin [Phys. Rev. B \textbf{35}, 2273 (1987)], a variational set of Wannier-like functions is generated self-consistently within a finite Wannier domain and used to construct the charge density, electrostatic potential, and per cell total energy of the extended system. The occupied space can be determined entirely from the Wannier-like functions. Electronic band structures can be recovered in a post-processing step by solving the full Hamiltonian in a Bloch-like basis constructed from Gaussian orbitals. A key feature of the method is that it can incorporate combined translation--rotation, or screw, symmetries, enabling efficient simulations of chiral and helical systems with finite twist angles at essentially the same computational cost as systems described by pure translational symmetry. The approach is validated through calculations on linear and twisted $\mathrm{{-}C{\equiv}C{-}}$ and $\mathrm{{-}Li{-}F{-}}$ chains, as well as graphene, where total energies and band structures show excellent agreement with reference periodic calculations. To illustrate the ability of the method to treat three-dimensional systems, it is further applied to AA graphite, in which carbon atoms in adjacent graphene layers are aligned directly above one another, as well as helically stacked AA graphite structures. The Wannier-first framework provides a practical route for treating extended systems with nontrivial translational, rotational, and screw symmetries, and provides a natural foundation for the implementation of orbital-dependent functionals such as the Perdew--Zunger self-interaction correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于扩展体系的实空间DFT公式，其中局域的Wannier-like函数直接从局域高斯基函数中构造，无需在自洽循环中显式计算标准的Bloch态。该方法基于Pederson和Lin的框架，在有限的Wannier域内自洽生成变分的Wannier-like函数，用于构建电荷密度、静电势和每单元格总能量。该方法的突出特点是能够纳入联合平移-旋转（螺旋）对称性，使得手性和螺旋体系（具有有限扭转角）的计算成本与纯平移对称体系基本相同。通过对线性及扭曲的-C≡C-链、-Li-F-链、石墨烯和AA石墨等体系的验证，总能量和能带结构与参考周期计算高度一致。
AI.motivation: 传统DFT依赖于Bloch态和周期平移对称性，难以高效处理具有旋转、螺旋等非平凡对称性的扩展体系（如手性/螺旋结构）。作者希望开发一种不依赖显式Bloch态计算的实空间DFT方法，同时为轨道依赖泛函（如PZ自相互作用修正）提供自然的基础。
AI.method: 采用"Wannier-first"框架：从局域高斯基函数出发，基于Pederson和Lin的公式化方法，在有限Wannier域内自洽生成一组变分的Wannier-like函数。这些函数用于构建扩展体系的电荷密度、静电势和每单元格总能量，占据空间完全由Wannier-like函数确定。能带结构通过在后续后处理步骤中，以高斯轨道构造的Bloch-like基求解完整哈密顿量来恢复。该框架可自然结合平移-旋转（螺旋）对称操作。
AI.result: 方法在线性及扭曲的-C≡C-链和-Li-F-链、石墨烯上得到验证，总能量和能带结构与参考周期计算吻合良好。进一步应用于AA石墨及螺旋堆叠的AA石墨结构，展示了对三维扩展体系的处理能力。螺旋体系的计算成本与纯平移对称体系基本相同。
AI.conclusion: 该Wannier-first框架为处理具有非平凡平移、旋转和螺旋对称性的扩展体系提供了实用路径，并为实现PZ自相互作用修正等轨道依赖泛函奠定了自然基础。

title: Machine Learning Local Potentials for Accelerated Electron-Phonon Interactions Calculations within the Projector Augmented-Wave Framework
summary: Electron-phonon interactions govern carrier dynamics, transport, and many optical and quantum phenomena in solids, but finite-displacement calculations within the projector augmented-wave (PAW) framework require up to 6N self-consistent supercell calculations for an N-atom system, making them costly for large, low-symmetry, and disordered materials. We introduce MLLocP, a machine learning strategy that learns the self-consistent local potential on real-space grids and supplies its displacement derivatives to the evaluation of all-electron PAW electron-phonon matrix elements. Analysis of the PAW decomposition identifies the local-potential contribution as a natural target for machine learning, while the remaining PAW quantities are retained within the established VASP/PHELEL framework. Using targeted grid-point sampling and feature-diversity selection for efficient model training, we validate MLLocP for elemental Cu, polar BAs, and chemically disordered Cu3Au. The learned potentials and their resulting displacement derivatives closely reproduce direct density functional theory calculations, yielding transport coefficients within approximately 3.5% for BAs mobility, 8% for Cu conductivity, and 11% for Cu3Au conductivity. For the 32-atom Cu3Au special quasirandom structure, using 40 sampled configurations reduces the number of self-consistent calculations by about fivefold relative to the 192 displaced structures required directly; using 20 or 10 configurations increases the acceleration to approximately 10- and 20-fold, with conductivity errors of 14.3% and 18.6%, respectively. MLLocP thus provides a scalable route to PAW electron-phonon calculations in complex materials while preserving the underlying all-electron formalism.

AI.tldr: MLLocP是一种机器学习策略，通过学习实空间网格上的自洽局域势及其位移导数，用于高效计算PAW框架下的电子-声子矩阵元，大幅减少自洽超胞计算次数，并在保持全电子形式主义的同时实现对复杂材料输运系数的准确预测。
AI.motivation: 传统PAW框架下的有限位移电子-声子计算需要对N原子体系进行多达6N次自洽超胞计算，对于大型、低对称性和无序材料而言计算成本过高，严重制约了这类材料中电子-声子相互作用的深入研究。
AI.method: MLLocP通过机器学习从实空间网格上学习自洽局域势，并将其位移导数用于所有电子PAW电子-声子矩阵元的计算。方法利用PAW分解分析确定局域势贡献作为机器学习的自然目标，其余PAW量仍由VASP/PHELEL框架处理；采用定向网格点采样和特征多样性选择以提高模型训练效率。
AI.result: 在元素Cu、极性BAs和化学无序Cu3Au上的验证表明：BAs迁移率误差约3.5%，Cu电导率误差约8%，Cu3Au电导率误差约11%。对于32原子Cu3Au特殊准随机结构，使用40个采样构型即可将自洽计算次数减少约5倍；使用20个或10个构型可实现约10倍和20倍的加速，电导率误差分别为14.3%和18.6%。
AI.conclusion: MLLocP为复杂材料中的PAW电子-声子计算提供了一条可扩展的路径，在大幅降低计算成本的同时保持了底层全电子形式主义的准确性和物理完整性。

title: In silico design of magnonic lasing in constricted waveguides
summary: Analogue black-hole systems have been proposed in various physical platforms, including magnetic materials, offering rich physics and promising applications such as wave lasing. However, their practical realization and characterization remain largely unexplored. Here, we present an in silico study of magnonic black-hole phenomena in constricted ferromagnetic waveguides driven by spin-polarized currents. Using micromagnetic simulations with a two-dimensional Poisson solver to obtain realistic current-density profiles, we demonstrate the formation of a double-hole cavity bounded by analogue event horizons, enabling resonant spin-wave amplification. We characterize the resonances as a function of magnetic and geometric parameters and identify the corresponding spin-wave modes. We further show that gradual tapers enhance transmission by suppressing spin-wave reflections, while interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction can mimic the current-induced Doppler shift, substantially reducing the critical current density required for applications and, consequently, Joule heating. Finally, we demonstrate a spin-wave laser in which thermally excited spin waves undergo selective amplification and coherent emission at well-defined resonance frequencies. These results provide design principles for magnonic analogues of gravitational systems and point toward their potential for advanced spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过微磁模拟研究受限铁磁波导中的magnonic黑洞现象，展示了由自旋极化电流驱动的双孔腔体形成类比事件视界，实现共振自旋波放大，并进一步展示了自旋波激光器的工作机制。
AI.motivation: 类比黑洞系统已在多种物理平台被提出，包括磁性材料，具有丰富的物理内涵和有前景的应用（如波激射）。然而，其实际实现和表征在很大程度上仍未探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用微磁模拟结合二维泊松求解器获得实际电流密度分布，在受限铁磁波导中研究自旋极化电流驱动的magnonic黑洞现象。通过调节磁场和几何参数对共振进行表征，并考察了锥形过渡结构和界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用的影响。
AI.result: 展示了由类比事件视界界定的双孔腔体形成，实现共振自旋波放大；渐变锥形结构可增强透射并抑制自旋波反射；界面DMI可模拟电流引起的多普勒频移，显著降低所需临界电流密度和焦耳热；最终演示了热激发自旋波选择性放大并在明确共振频率下相干发射的自旋波激光器。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为magnonic引力类比系统提供了设计原则，并展示了其在先进自旋电子学应用中的潜力。

title: Disorder-driven competing magnetic interactions and glassy magnetic behavior in quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe
summary: In this combined experimental and theoretical study, we investigate the role of disorder in governing the magnetic ground state of the quaternary Heusler alloy FeRuMnGe. In the FeRuMnZ (Z = Ga, Si) series, chemical substitution modifies atomic ordering and electronic structure, resulting in distinct magnetic ground states. Motivated by this, we extend the series to FeRuMnGe. X-ray diffraction reveals B2-type antisite disorder, where Fe--Ru and Mn--Ge intermix. Theoretical calculations show that such disorder modifies exchange interactions, leading to competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic couplings, and drives the system from half-metallic to metallic. Magnetic measurements reveal competing interactions, giving rise to a cluster-glass state coexisting with long-range magnetic order. The absence of a thermodynamic signature at $T_f$, together with ac susceptibility and relaxation measurements, supports the presence of short-range magnetic interactions and a glassy magnetic state. The compound exhibits an enhanced magnetic response below $\sim 161$ K and a maximum magnetization of $\sim 1.64~μ_B$/f.u. at 5 T. Overall, this work establishes a direct correlation between antisite disorder, competing exchange interactions, and glassy magnetism in quaternary Heusler alloys. Combined experimental results and theoretical calculations reveal that disorder drives the system from an AFM-dominated state in FeRuMnSi to an FM-dominated state in FeRuMnGe, providing deeper insight into the role of the extent of disorder in governing the magnetic properties of QHAs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验与理论相结合的方法，研究了四元Heusler合金FeRuMnGe中无序对其磁基态的影响。X射线衍射揭示B2型反位无序（Fe-Ru和Mn-Ge混合），理论计算表明这种无序会修饰交换相互作用，导致铁磁与反铁磁耦合竞争，并使体系从半金属转变为金属。磁性测量显示竞争相互作用导致团簇玻璃态与长程磁有序共存，该化合物在~161 K以下表现出增强的磁响应，在5 T下最大磁化强度约1.64 μ_B/f.u.。研究建立了反位无序、竞争交换相互作用与玻璃态磁性之间的直接关联，显示无序驱动体系从FeRuMnSi中的反铁磁主导态转变为FeRuMnGe中的铁磁主导态。
AI.motivation: 理解化学取代如何通过改变原子有序度和电子结构来调控四元Heusler合金的磁基态，特别是无序程度在决定磁性性质中的作用。作者将已有FeRuMnZ（Z=Ga, Si）系列的体系扩展至FeRuMnGe，以期更深入地揭示无序与磁性之间的关联。
AI.method: 采用实验与理论计算结合的途径：X射线衍射表征晶体结构中的反位无序；理论计算分析无序对交换相互作用和电子结构的影响；磁性测量（包括ac磁化率、弛豫测量）表征磁基态和竞争相互作用。
AI.result: FeRuMnGe存在B2型反位无序；无序导致铁磁与反铁磁交换耦合竞争，使体系从半金属变为金属；磁性测量显示团簇玻璃态与长程磁有序共存，无T_f处的热力学特征，证实短程磁相互作用存在；化合物在~161 K以下显示增强磁响应，5 T下最大磁化强度约1.64 μ_B/f.u.；无序将体系从FeRuMnSi的反铁磁主导推向FeRuMnGe的铁磁主导。
AI.conclusion: 本研究确立了反位无序与玻璃态磁性之间的直接因果关系，证明了无序程度是调控四元Heusler合金磁基态的关键因素，为理解和设计具有可调磁性能的Heusler合金提供了重要的理论指导和实验依据。

title: Prototype-guided transfer of sparse literature knowledge for electrolyte additive discovery
summary: Electrolyte additive discovery remains challenging because experimentally validated molecules are sparse, whereas accessible chemical spaces are vast and largely unlabeled. This challenge is amplified in lithium-ion batteries, where additive performance arises from coupled interfacial reactions rather than a single molecular property. Here, we develop a prototype-guided molecular intelligence, ProtoMI, a literature-driven framework that learns transferable structural priors from reported electrolyte additives and uses them to prioritize candidates in unlabeled chemical space. For boron-containing additives, ProtoMI combines 126 literature-reported molecules with 179,977 unlabeled candidates. Graph contrastive learning identifies seven chemically interpretable prototypes from the reported additives, and prototype guided semi-supervised contrastive learning adapts these prototypes to the candidate space under source-target distribution mismatch. In retrospective temporal validation, ProtoMI achieves enrichment factors of 9.2-45.6 while screening less than 2% of the candidate space. A subsequent translation step identifies four commercially accessible candidates. One representative candidate, 4,4,5,5-Tetramethyl-2-[10-(1naphthyl)anthracen-9-yl]-1,3,2-dioxaborolane (TNDB), improves high-temperature LiFePO4||graphite cycling at 55 °C by 34.93% relative to the baseline electrolyte. An arsenal of characterizations and operando optical fiber Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy suggest that TNDB forms B-containing, F/P/O-modified inorganic interphases, suppresses solvent decomposition and reduces Fe deposition on graphite. This case study shows how sparse literature knowledge can guide experimentally efficient molecular discovery in data-scarce battery-additive spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProtoMI，一种基于文献驱动和原型引导的分子智能框架，用于在数据稀缺的锂离子电池电解液添加剂空间中高效发现新分子。通过126个文献报道的含硼添加剂和179,977个未标记候选分子的图对比学习，ProtoMI成功识别出7个化学可解释原型，并在回顾性时间验证中实现9.2-45.6倍的富集因子（仅筛选不到2%的候选空间）。发现的新添加剂TNDB在55°C高温下使LiFePO4||石墨电池循环性能提升34.93%，并通过多种表征验证了其界面机制。
AI.motivation: 电解液添加剂发现面临两大核心挑战：(1)化学空间巨大且缺乏标记数据，实验中已验证的分子非常稀疏；(2)锂离子电池中添加剂性能源于复杂的耦合界面反应，而非单一分子性质可预测。这使得传统高通量筛选或单一性质预测方法难以奏效，亟需能从稀疏文献知识中提取可迁移结构先验并进行有效候选空间探索的智能框架。
AI.method: ProtoMI采用两阶段框架：(1)从文献中收集126个已报道含硼添加剂分子作为标记数据，结合179,977个未标记候选分子；(2)利用图对比学习从报道添加剂中识别7个化学可解释的原型（prototypes）；(3)通过原型引导的半监督对比学习，在源域（文献分子）与目标域（候选空间）分布不匹配条件下自适应迁移原型；(4)最后进行翻译步骤筛选出4个商业可获得的候选分子用于实验验证。
AI.result: 回顾性时间验证中，ProtoMI筛选不到2%的候选空间即实现9.2-45.6的富集因子。从预测结果中翻译出4个商业可达候选分子，其中TNDB在55°C高温下使LiFePO4||graphite电池循环性能较基线电解液提升34.93%。多种表征和原位光纤FTIR表明，TNDB形成含B、F/P/O修饰的无机界面相，抑制溶剂分解并减少石墨上铁的沉积。
AI.conclusion: 该案例证明，稀疏的文献知识能够有效指导数据稀缺电池添加剂空间中的实验高效分子发现。ProtoMI框架展示了在标记数据极为有限的情况下，通过对比学习提取结构先验并引导候选空间探索的可行性，为更广泛的材料智能发现提供了方法论参考。
